382inline bool is_finite_command(const AxisCommand &command)
383{
384 return std::isfinite(command.value) && std::isfinite(command.velocity) &&
385 std::isfinite(command.acceleration) && std::isfinite(command.deceleration) &&
386 std::isfinite(command.jerk) && std::isfinite(command.torque_limit) &&
387 command.torque_limit >= 0.0 && std::isfinite(command.torque_ramp) &&
388 command.torque_ramp >= 0.0 && std::isfinite(command.end_velocity);
389}
390
391inline bool is_valid_direction(Direction direction)
392{
393 return direction == Direction::current || direction == Direction::positive ||
394 direction == Direction::negative || direction == Direction::shortest_way;
395}
396
397inline bool is_valid_buffer_mode(BufferMode mode)
398{
399 return mode == BufferMode::aborting || mode == BufferMode::buffered ||
400 mode == BufferMode::blending_low || mode == BufferMode::blending_high;
401}

403inline bool is_continuous_kind(CommandKind kind)
404{
405 return kind == CommandKind::move_continuous_absolute ||
406 kind == CommandKind::move_continuous_relative;

492 rt::ErrorCode set_power(bool enabled, bool enable_positive = true,
493 bool enable_negative = true)
494 {
495 if (snapshot_.status == AxisStatus::errorstop && enabled)
496 {
497 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
498 }
499 if (enabled && !power_feedback_)
500 {
501 return rt::ErrorCode::precondition_failed;
502 }
503 const bool positive_changed = positive_enabled_ != (enabled && enable_positive);
504 const bool negative_changed = negative_enabled_ != (enabled && enable_negative);
505 positive_enabled_ = enabled && enable_positive;
506 negative_enabled_ = enabled && enable_negative;
507
508 // MC_Power is level-controlled and called every scan cycle. A power
509 // transition always aborts motion; changing a feed enable only aborts
510 // a command that would continue into the newly disabled direction.
511 if (enabled == snapshot_.powered)
512 {
513 if ((positive_changed || negative_changed) &&
514 !active_direction_enabled())
515 {
516 abort_motion();
517 snapshot_.status = AxisStatus::standstill;
518 }
519 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
520 }
521
522 abort_motion();
523 snapshot_.powered = enabled;
524 snapshot_.status = enabled ? AxisStatus::standstill : AxisStatus::disabled;
525 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
526 }
527
528 // External power-stage feedback is separate from MC_Power's normal
529 // level-controlled disable. Losing feedback while enabled is an axis
530 // fault, not a user abort.
531 rt::ErrorCode set_power_feedback(bool available)
532 {
533 power_feedback_ = available;
534 if (available || !snapshot_.powered)
535 {
536 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
537 }
538 snapshot_.powered = false;
539 return trigger_error(rt::ErrorCode::precondition_failed);
540 }

603 rt::ErrorCode shift_coordinates(double delta)
604 {
605 // MC_SetPosition remaps the complete absolute coordinate domain,
606 // including active and queued absolute targets.
607 const bool has_position_profile = active_ &&
608 active_command_.kind != CommandKind::move_velocity &&
609 active_command_.kind != CommandKind::torque &&
610 active_command_.kind != CommandKind::acceleration_profile;
611 if (!std::isfinite(delta) || sync_kind_ != SyncKind::none || stream_active_ ||
612 superimposed_active_ || group_blocks_standalone_motion())
613 {
614 return rt::ErrorCode::precondition_failed;
615 }
616 if (!std::isfinite(snapshot_.command_position + delta) ||
617 !std::isfinite(snapshot_.actual_position + delta) ||
618 !target_inside_limits(snapshot_.command_position + delta, true) ||
619 !target_inside_limits(snapshot_.actual_position + delta, true))
620 {
621 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
622 }
623 if (has_position_profile && (!std::isfinite(active_target_ + delta) ||
624 !target_inside_limits(active_target_ + delta, true)))
625 {
626 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
627 }
628 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < queue_.size(); ++i)
629 {
630 if ((queue_[i].kind == CommandKind::move_absolute ||
631 queue_[i].kind == CommandKind::move_continuous_absolute) &&
632 (!std::isfinite(queue_[i].value + delta) ||
633 !target_inside_limits(queue_[i].value + delta, true)))
634 {
635 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
636 }
637 }
638 if (has_position_profile && active_profile_.translate(delta) != rt::ErrorCode::ok)
639 {
640 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
641 }
642 snapshot_.command_position += delta;
643 snapshot_.actual_position += delta;
644 if (active_)
645 {
646 if (has_position_profile)
647 {
648 active_target_ += delta;
649 active_last_sample_ += delta;
650 }
651 if (active_command_.kind == CommandKind::move_absolute ||
652 active_command_.kind == CommandKind::move_continuous_absolute)
653 {
654 active_command_.value += delta;
655 }
656 }
657 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < queue_.size(); ++i)
658 {
659 if (queue_[i].kind == CommandKind::move_absolute ||
660 queue_[i].kind == CommandKind::move_continuous_absolute)
661 {
662 queue_[i].value += delta;
663 }
664 }
665 for (ProbeSlot &probe : probes_)
666 {
667 if (probe.captured)
668 probe.recorded_position += delta;
669 if (probe.window_only)
670 {
671 probe.first_position += delta;
672 probe.last_position += delta;
673 }
674 }
675 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
676 }
677
678 // Part 5 flying reference: remap the current coordinate while preserving
679 // the numeric absolute targets of the active and queued motion commands.
680 rt::ErrorCode set_position_on_the_fly(double delta)
681 {
682 if (!active_ || !std::isfinite(delta) || sync_kind_ != SyncKind::none || stream_active_ ||
683 superimposed_active_ || group_blocks_standalone_motion())
684 {
685 return rt::ErrorCode::precondition_failed;
686 }
687
688 const double position = snapshot_.command_position + delta;
689 const double actual_position = snapshot_.actual_position + delta;
690 if (!std::isfinite(position) || !std::isfinite(actual_position) ||
691 !target_inside_limits(position, true) || !target_inside_limits(actual_position, true))
692 {
693 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
694 }
695
696 const bool profile_driven = active_command_.kind != CommandKind::move_velocity &&
697 active_command_.kind != CommandKind::torque &&
698 active_command_.kind != CommandKind::acceleration_profile &&
699 !continuous_holding_ && !override_paused_;
700 otg::Profile1D updated_profile{};
701 if (profile_driven)
702 {
703 if (override_braking_)
704 {
705 updated_profile = active_profile_;
706 if (updated_profile.translate(delta) != rt::ErrorCode::ok)
707 {
708 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
709 }
710 }
711 else
712 {
713 const double end_velocity = is_continuous_kind(active_command_.kind)
714 ? active_command_.end_velocity * override_
715 : 0.0;
716 const otg::Limits1D limits = scaled_limits(active_command_);
717 const rt::Result<otg::Profile1D> replanned = otg::plan_time_optimal(
718 {position, snapshot_.command_velocity, snapshot_.command_acceleration},
719 {active_target_, end_velocity, 0.0}, limits);
720 if (!replanned)
721 {
722 return replanned.error();
723 }
724 updated_profile = replanned.value();
725 }
726 }
727
728 snapshot_.command_position = position;
729 snapshot_.actual_position = actual_position;
730 if (profile_driven)
731 {
732 active_profile_ = updated_profile;
733 if (override_braking_)
734 {
735 active_last_sample_ += delta;
736 }
737 else
738 {
739 active_tick_ = 0;
740 active_last_sample_ = position;
741 snapshot_.active_command_reached_target = false;
742 }
743 }
744 for (ProbeSlot &probe : probes_)
745 {
746 if (probe.captured)
747 probe.recorded_position += delta;
748 if (probe.window_only)
749 {
750 probe.first_position += delta;
751 probe.last_position += delta;
752 }
753 }
754 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
755 }

761 {

763 value = limits_.max_position_enabled;
764 break;
765 case AxisParameter::enable_limit_neg:
766 value = limits_.min_position_enabled;

773
774 rt::ErrorCode write_parameter(AxisParameter parameter, double value)
775 {
776 if (!std::isfinite(value))
777 {
778 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
779 }
780 switch (parameter)
781 {
782 case AxisParameter::sw_limit_pos:
783 if (limits_.min_position_enabled && limits_.max_position_enabled &&
784 value < limits_.min_position)
785 {
786 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
787 }
788 limits_.max_position = value;
789 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
790 case AxisParameter::sw_limit_neg:
791 if (limits_.min_position_enabled && limits_.max_position_enabled &&
792 value > limits_.max_position)
793 {
794 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
795 }
796 limits_.min_position = value;
797 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
798 case AxisParameter::max_velocity_system:
799 case AxisParameter::max_velocity_appl:
800 if (value <= 0.0)
801 {
802 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
803 }
804 limits_.max_velocity = value;
805 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
806 case AxisParameter::max_acceleration_system:
807 case AxisParameter::max_acceleration_appl:
808 if (value <= 0.0)
809 {
810 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
811 }
812 limits_.max_acceleration = value;
813 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
814 case AxisParameter::max_deceleration_system:
815 case AxisParameter::max_deceleration_appl:
816 if (value <= 0.0)
817 {
818 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
819 }
820 limits_.max_deceleration = value;
821 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
822 case AxisParameter::max_jerk_system:
823 case AxisParameter::max_jerk_appl:
824 if (value <= 0.0)
825 {
826 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
827 }
828 limits_.max_jerk = value;
829 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
830 default:
831 return rt::ErrorCode::unsupported;
832 }
833 }

890 // MC_SetOverride carries the KB-003 contract: newly planned commands scale
891 // by the override, velocity commands respond per cycle through
892 // signed_velocity(), and an active profile-driven command re-plans from
893 // its current state under the re-scaled velocity limit (an override drop
894 // below the current velocity plans a deceleration entry). A failed replan
895 // keeps the previous override and the running profile untouched.
896 rt::ErrorCode set_override(double factor)
897 {
898 return set_override(factor, acceleration_override_, jerk_override_);
899 }
900
901 rt::ErrorCode set_override(double velocity_factor,
902 double acceleration_factor,
903 double jerk_factor)
904 {
905 if (group_blocks_standalone_motion())
906 {
907 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
908 }
909 if (!std::isfinite(velocity_factor) || velocity_factor < 0.0 ||
910 velocity_factor > 1.0 || !std::isfinite(acceleration_factor) ||
911 acceleration_factor <= 0.0 || acceleration_factor > 1.0 ||
912 !std::isfinite(jerk_factor) || jerk_factor <= 0.0 ||
913 jerk_factor > 1.0)
914 {
915 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
916 }
917 const double previous_velocity = override_;
918 const double previous_acceleration = acceleration_override_;
919 const double previous_jerk = jerk_override_;
920 override_ = velocity_factor;
921 acceleration_override_ = acceleration_factor;
922 jerk_override_ = jerk_factor;
923 if (previous_velocity == velocity_factor &&
924 previous_acceleration == acceleration_factor &&
925 previous_jerk == jerk_factor)
926 {
927 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
928 }
929
930 const auto restore_previous = [&]() {
931 override_ = previous_velocity;
932 acceleration_override_ = previous_acceleration;
933 jerk_override_ = previous_jerk;
934 };
935
936 if (velocity_factor == 0.0 && active_ && active_command_.kind != CommandKind::halt &&
937 active_command_.kind != CommandKind::stop)
938 {
939 const double v0 = snapshot_.command_velocity;
940 const double a0 = snapshot_.command_acceleration;
941 const double scaled_acceleration =
942 active_command_.acceleration * acceleration_override_;
943 const double scaled_deceleration =
944 active_command_.deceleration * acceleration_override_;
945 const double scaled_jerk = active_command_.jerk * jerk_override_;
946 const otg::Limits1D halt_limits{std::fabs(v0) + active_command_.velocity + 1e-9,
947 std::fmax(std::fabs(a0), scaled_acceleration),
948 scaled_deceleration, scaled_jerk};
949 double brake_velocity = v0;
950 double brake_shift = 0.0;
951 if (a0 != 0.0)
952 {
953 const double zero_cycles = std::ceil(std::fabs(a0) / scaled_jerk);
954 brake_velocity += 0.5 * a0 * zero_cycles;
955 brake_shift += v0 * zero_cycles + a0 * zero_cycles * zero_cycles / 3.0;
956 }
957 const double stop_position =
958 snapshot_.command_position + brake_shift +
959 otg::detail::ramp_between(brake_velocity, 0.0, halt_limits).distance;
960 const rt::Result<otg::Profile1D> profile = otg::plan_time_optimal(
961 {snapshot_.command_position, v0, a0}, {stop_position, 0.0, 0.0}, halt_limits);
962 if (!profile)
963 {
964 restore_previous();
965 return profile.error();
966 }
967 active_profile_ = profile.value();
968 active_last_sample_ = snapshot_.command_position;
969 active_tick_ = 0;
970 override_braking_ = true;
971 override_paused_ = false;
972 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
973 }
974
975 if (previous_velocity == 0.0 && velocity_factor > 0.0 && override_paused_)
976 {
977 override_paused_ = false;
978 if (active_command_.kind == CommandKind::move_velocity || continuous_holding_)
979 {
980 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
981 }
982 const otg::Limits1D limits = scaled_limits(active_command_);
983 const double direction = active_target_ >= snapshot_.command_position ? 1.0 : -1.0;
984 const double end_velocity = is_continuous_kind(active_command_.kind)
985 ? direction * active_command_.end_velocity * velocity_factor
986 : 0.0;
987 const rt::Result<otg::Profile1D> profile =
988 otg::plan_time_optimal({snapshot_.command_position, 0.0, 0.0},
989 {active_target_, end_velocity, 0.0}, limits);
990 if (!profile)
991 {
992 restore_previous();
993 override_paused_ = true;
994 return profile.error();
995 }
996 active_profile_ = profile.value();
997 active_last_sample_ = snapshot_.command_position;
998 active_tick_ = 0;
999 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1000 }
1001
1002 const bool profile_driven = active_ && active_command_.kind != CommandKind::move_velocity &&
1003 active_command_.kind != CommandKind::halt &&
1004 active_command_.kind != CommandKind::stop;
1005 if (!profile_driven)
1006 {
1007 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1008 }
1009
1010 const double end_velocity = is_continuous_kind(active_command_.kind)
1011 ? active_command_.end_velocity * override_
1012 : 0.0;
1013 if (continuous_holding_)
1014 {
1015 continuous_hold_velocity_ = end_velocity;
1016 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1017 }
1018
1019 const otg::Limits1D limits = scaled_limits(active_command_);
1020 const rt::Result<otg::Profile1D> profile =
1021 otg::plan_time_optimal({snapshot_.command_position, snapshot_.command_velocity,
1022 snapshot_.command_acceleration},
1023 {active_target_, end_velocity, 0.0}, limits);
1024 if (!profile)
1025 {
1026 restore_previous();
1027 return profile.error();
1028 }
1029 active_profile_ = profile.value();
1030 active_tick_ = 0;
1031 active_last_sample_ = snapshot_.command_position;
1032 continuous_hold_velocity_ = end_velocity;
1033 snapshot_.active_command_reached_target = false;
1034 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1035 }
1036
1037 rt::ErrorCode trigger_error(rt::ErrorCode code = rt::ErrorCode::precondition_failed)
1038 {
1039 if (snapshot_.active_command_id != 0)
1040 {
1041 record_command_error(snapshot_.active_command_id, code);
1042 }
1043 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < queue_.size(); ++i)
1044 {
1045 record_command_error(queue_[i].command_id, code);
1046 }
1047 if (sync_id_ != 0)
1048 record_command_error(sync_id_, code);
1049 if (superimposed_id_ != 0)
1050 record_command_error(superimposed_id_, code);
1051 if (stream_id_ != 0)
1052 record_command_error(stream_id_, code);
1053 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < management_queue_.size(); ++i)
1054 {
1055 remember_management_result(management_queue_[i].command_id, code);
1056 }
1057 management_queue_.clear();
1058 abort_motion();
1059 snapshot_.error = true;
1060 snapshot_.error_id = code;
1061 snapshot_.status = AxisStatus::errorstop;
1062 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1063 }
1064
1065 rt::ErrorCode reset_error()
1066 {
1067 if (snapshot_.status != AxisStatus::errorstop)
1068 {
1069 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
1070 }
1071 snapshot_.error = false;
1072 snapshot_.error_id = rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1073 snapshot_.status = snapshot_.powered ? AxisStatus::standstill : AxisStatus::disabled;
1074 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1075 }
1076
1077 rt::Result<std::uint32_t> submit(AxisCommand command)
1078 {
1079 if (group_blocks_standalone_motion())
1080 {
1081 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument);
1082 }
1083 return submit_impl(command);
1084 }
1085
1086 rt::Result<std::uint32_t> submit_acceleration_profile(const ProfileSegment *segments,
1087 std::size_t segment_count,
1088 double acceleration_scale,
1089 double acceleration_offset,
1090 double time_scale)
1091 {
1092 if (group_blocks_standalone_motion() || !snapshot_.powered ||
1093 snapshot_.status == AxisStatus::errorstop || segments == nullptr ||
1094 segment_count == 0 || segment_count > QueueCapacity ||
1095 !std::isfinite(acceleration_scale) || !std::isfinite(acceleration_offset) ||
1096 !std::isfinite(time_scale) || time_scale <= 0.0)
1097 {
1098 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument);
1099 }
1100 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < segment_count; ++i)
1101 {
1102 const double acceleration =
1103 segments[i].target * acceleration_scale + acceleration_offset;
1104 const double duration = static_cast<double>(segments[i].duration_cycles) * time_scale;
1105 if (!std::isfinite(acceleration) || segments[i].relative ||
1106 segments[i].duration_cycles <= 0 || !std::isfinite(duration) ||
1107 std::round(duration) < 1.0 || std::round(duration) >= std::ldexp(1.0, 63))
1108 {
1109 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument);
1110 }
1111 }
1112
1113 abort_motion();
1114 acceleration_segment_count_ = segment_count;
1115 acceleration_segment_index_ = 0;
1116 acceleration_segment_tick_ = 0;
1117 acceleration_profile_completed_ = false;
1118 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < segment_count; ++i)
1119 {
1120 AxisCommand storage{};
1121 storage.kind = CommandKind::acceleration_profile;
1122 storage.value = segments[i].target * acceleration_scale + acceleration_offset;
1123 storage.min_duration_cycles = static_cast<std::int64_t>(
1124 std::llround(static_cast<double>(segments[i].duration_cycles) * time_scale));
1125 queue_.push_back(storage);
1126 }
1127 active_ = true;
1128 active_command_ = {};
1129 active_command_.kind = CommandKind::acceleration_profile;
1130 active_command_.command_id = next_command_id_++;
1131 snapshot_.active_command_id = active_command_.command_id;
1132 snapshot_.active_command_reached_target = false;
1133 snapshot_.status = AxisStatus::continuous_motion;
1134 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::success(active_command_.command_id);
1135 }
1136
1137 // Validate an aborting position command followed by buffered position
1138 // commands without changing axis state. Profile-table and homing facades
1139 // use this to reject the whole sequence before the first command starts.
1140 rt::ErrorCode preflight_position_sequence(const AxisCommand *commands,
1141 std::size_t command_count,
1142 bool enforce_soft_limits = false) const
1143 {
1144 if (commands == nullptr || command_count == 0 || command_count > QueueCapacity ||
1145 group_blocks_standalone_motion() || !snapshot_.powered ||
1146 snapshot_.status == AxisStatus::errorstop || snapshot_.error)
1147 {
1148 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
1149 }
1150
1151 const BufferMode first_mode = commands[0].buffer_mode;
1152 if(!is_valid_buffer_mode(first_mode))
1153 {
1154 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
1155 }
1156 if(active_ && first_mode != BufferMode::aborting &&
1157 queue_.size() + command_count > QueueCapacity)
1158 {
1159 return rt::ErrorCode::capacity_exceeded;
1160 }
1161 double from_position = first_mode == BufferMode::aborting
1162 ? snapshot_.command_position
1163 : queued_endpoint();
1164 double from_velocity = first_mode == BufferMode::aborting
1165 ? snapshot_.command_velocity
1166 : 0.0;
1167 double from_acceleration = first_mode == BufferMode::aborting
1168 ? snapshot_.command_acceleration
1169 : 0.0;
1170 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < command_count; ++i)
1171 {
1172 const AxisCommand &command = commands[i];
1173 const BufferMode expected_mode = i == 0 ? first_mode : BufferMode::buffered;
1174 if (command.buffer_mode != expected_mode ||
1175 (command.kind != CommandKind::move_absolute &&
1176 command.kind != CommandKind::move_relative) ||
1177 (command.kind == CommandKind::move_absolute &&
1178 !is_valid_direction(command.direction)) ||
1179 !is_finite_command(command) || command.velocity <= 0.0 ||
1180 command.acceleration <= 0.0 || command.deceleration <= 0.0 || command.jerk <= 0.0 ||
1181 command.min_duration_cycles < 0)
1182 {
1183 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
1184 }
1185
1186 const double target = command.kind == CommandKind::move_relative
1187 ? from_position + command.value
1188 : command.value;
1189 if (!std::isfinite(target))
1190 {
1191 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
1192 }
1193 if (!target_inside_limits(target, enforce_soft_limits))
1194 {
1195 return rt::ErrorCode::out_of_range;
1196 }
1197
1198 const otg::Limits1D limits = scaled_limits(command);
1199 const rt::Result<otg::Profile1D> profile = otg::plan_time_optimal(
1200 {from_position, from_velocity, from_acceleration}, {target, 0.0, 0.0}, limits);
1201 if (!profile)
1202 {
1203 return profile.error();
1204 }
1205
1206 from_position = target;
1207 from_velocity = 0.0;
1208 from_acceleration = 0.0;
1209 }
1210 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1211 }
1212
1213 private:
1214 friend class AxisGroup;
1215
1216 static rt::Result<MotionLimits> si_to_limits(const rt::CycleConfig &cycle,
1217 const AxisSiConfig &config,
1218 MotionLimits base)
1219 {
1220 if(cycle.period_ns() <= 0) {
1221 return rt::Result<MotionLimits>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument);
1222 }
1223 base.max_velocity = cycle.velocity_to_cycle(config.max_velocity);
1224 base.max_acceleration = cycle.acceleration_to_cycle(config.max_acceleration);
1225 base.max_deceleration = cycle.acceleration_to_cycle(config.max_deceleration);
1226 base.max_jerk = cycle.jerk_to_cycle(config.max_jerk);
1227 base.min_position = config.min_position;
1228 base.max_position = config.max_position;
1229 base.min_position_enabled = config.min_position_enabled;
1230 base.max_position_enabled = config.max_position_enabled;
1231 if(!std::isfinite(base.max_velocity) || !std::isfinite(base.max_acceleration) ||
1232 !std::isfinite(base.max_deceleration) || !std::isfinite(base.max_jerk) ||
1233 (config.min_position_enabled && !std::isfinite(config.min_position)) ||
1234 (config.max_position_enabled && !std::isfinite(config.max_position)) ||
1235 (config.min_position_enabled && config.max_position_enabled &&
1236 config.min_position > config.max_position) ||
1237 base.max_velocity <= 0.0 || base.max_acceleration <= 0.0 ||
1238 base.max_deceleration <= 0.0 || base.max_jerk <= 0.0) {
1239 return rt::Result<MotionLimits>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument);
1240 }
1241 return rt::Result<MotionLimits>::success(base);
1242 }

1244 rt::ErrorCode set_group_owner(void *owner, const GroupStatus *status = nullptr)
1245 {
1246 group_owner_ = owner;
1247 group_status_ = owner == nullptr ? nullptr : status;
1248 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1249 }
1250
1251 rt::Result<std::uint32_t> submit_group_owned(AxisCommand command)
1252 {
1253 return submit_impl(command);
1254 }
1255
1256 rt::ErrorCode preflight_group_owned(AxisCommand command) const
1257 {
1258 if (!snapshot_.powered || snapshot_.status == AxisStatus::errorstop ||
1259 !is_valid_buffer_mode(command.buffer_mode) ||
1260 !is_finite_command(command) || command.velocity <= 0.0 || command.acceleration <= 0.0 ||
1261 command.deceleration <= 0.0 || command.jerk <= 0.0 ||
1262 (command.kind != CommandKind::move_absolute &&
1263 command.kind != CommandKind::move_relative))
1264 {
1265 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
1266 }
1267
1268 command = normalize(command, queued_endpoint());
1269 if (!target_inside_limits(command.value))
1270 {
1271 return rt::ErrorCode::out_of_range;
1272 }
1273 const otg::Limits1D limits = scaled_limits(command);
1274 const rt::Result<otg::Profile1D> profile =
1275 otg::plan_time_optimal({snapshot_.command_position, snapshot_.command_velocity,
1276 snapshot_.command_acceleration},
1277 {command.value, 0.0, 0.0}, limits);
1278 return profile ? rt::ErrorCode::ok : profile.error();
1279 }
1280
1281 void abort_group_owned_motion()
1282 {
1283 abort_motion();
1284 if (snapshot_.status != AxisStatus::errorstop)
1285 {
1286 snapshot_.status = snapshot_.powered ? AxisStatus::standstill : AxisStatus::disabled;
1287 }
1288 }
1289
1290 // KB-068: once the owning group leaves standby, public member motion
1291 // entry points must not become a second writer.
1292 bool group_blocks_standalone_motion() const
1293 {
1294 return group_owner_ != nullptr &&
1295 (group_status_ == nullptr || *group_status_ != GroupStatus::standby);
1296 }
1297
1298 // Pure admissibility prefix of submit_impl(): every rejection that only
1299 // reads state, in strict first-match order — each branch returns a
1300 // different code, so reordering them is an observable behavior change.
1301 //
1302 // The seam sits exactly at the first mutation in submit_impl(), the
1303 // command-id allocation. The two later rejections (the acceleration
1304 // profile takeover rule and the soft-limit check) deliberately stay
1305 // behind that allocation: a command rejected there has already consumed
1306 // a command id, and hoisting them would shift the observable command-id
1307 // sequence, which the golden replay baseline pins.
1308 rt::ErrorCode submit_admissibility(const AxisCommand &command) const
1309 {
1310 const bool torque = command.kind == CommandKind::torque;
1311 if (!snapshot_.powered || snapshot_.status == AxisStatus::errorstop ||
1312 !is_valid_buffer_mode(command.buffer_mode) ||
1313 !is_finite_command(command) ||
1314 (torque ? (command.velocity < 0.0 || command.acceleration < 0.0 ||
1315 command.deceleration < 0.0 || command.jerk < 0.0 ||
1316 !is_valid_direction(command.direction) ||
1317 command.direction == Direction::shortest_way)
1318 : (command.velocity <= 0.0 || command.acceleration <= 0.0 ||
1319 command.deceleration <= 0.0 || command.jerk <= 0.0)))
1320 {
1321 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
1322 }
1323 if(torque && command.buffer_mode != BufferMode::aborting) {
1324 // A torque command has no natural completion point. Matching the
1325 // Beckhoff CST contract, only an aborting takeover is defined.
1326 return rt::ErrorCode::unsupported;
1327 }
1328 if (stop_lock_id_ != 0 && command.kind != CommandKind::stop)
1329 {
1330 return rt::ErrorCode::precondition_failed;
1331 }
1332 if ((command.kind == CommandKind::move_absolute ||
1333 command.kind == CommandKind::move_continuous_absolute) &&
1334 !is_valid_direction(command.direction))
1335 {
1336 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
1337 }
1338
1339 // Queueing a motion command behind an engaged synchronization or a
1340 // stream session has no defined completion point; only aborting
1341 // commands may take over.
1342 if ((sync_kind_ != SyncKind::none || stream_active_) &&
1343 command.buffer_mode != BufferMode::aborting)
1344 {
1345 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
1346 }
1347 if (is_continuous_kind(command.kind) && command.end_velocity == 0.0)
1348 {
1349 return rt::ErrorCode::unsupported;
1350 }
1351 const double direction_reference =
1352 command.buffer_mode == BufferMode::aborting
1353 ? snapshot_.command_position
1354 : queued_endpoint();
1355 if (!command_direction_enabled(command, direction_reference))
1356 {
1357 return rt::ErrorCode::precondition_failed;
1358 }
1359 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1360 }
1361
1362 rt::Result<std::uint32_t> submit_impl(AxisCommand command)
1363 {
1364 const rt::ErrorCode admissible = submit_admissibility(command);
1365 if (admissible != rt::ErrorCode::ok)
1366 {
1367 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(admissible);
1368 }
1369
1370 if (command.command_id == 0)
1371 {
1372 command.command_id = next_command_id_++;
1373 }
1374
1375 if (command.kind == CommandKind::torque)
1376 {
1377 const double prior_torque = snapshot_.command_torque;
1378 abort_motion();
1379 active_ = true;
1380 active_command_ = command;
1381 torque_command_id_ = command.command_id;
1382 snapshot_.active_command_id = command.command_id;
1383 snapshot_.command_torque = command.torque_ramp == 0.0
1384 ? command.value
1385 : prior_torque;
1386 snapshot_.torque_velocity_limit = command.velocity;
1387 snapshot_.torque_acceleration_limit = command.acceleration;
1388 snapshot_.torque_deceleration_limit = command.deceleration;
1389 snapshot_.torque_jerk_limit = command.jerk;
1390 snapshot_.torque_direction = command.direction;
1391 snapshot_.torque_mode = true;
1392 snapshot_.status = AxisStatus::continuous_motion;
1393 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::success(command.command_id);
1394 }
1395 if (active_ && active_command_.kind == CommandKind::acceleration_profile &&
1396 command.buffer_mode != BufferMode::aborting)
1397 {
1398 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::unsupported);
1399 }
1400
1401 // The additive target resolves against the endpoint that was committed
1402 // before an aborting takeover discards it.
1403 const double takeover_endpoint = queued_endpoint();
1404 const AxisStatus takeover_status = snapshot_.status;
1405 // Aborting takeovers keep kinematic continuity: abort_motion() zeroes
1406 // the command velocity/acceleration, but the new command must plan
1407 // from the state the axis was actually in (KB-026).
1408 const double takeover_velocity = snapshot_.command_velocity;
1409 const double takeover_acceleration = snapshot_.command_acceleration;
1410 if (command.buffer_mode == BufferMode::aborting)
1411 {
1412 abort_motion();
1413 snapshot_.command_velocity = takeover_velocity;
1414 snapshot_.command_acceleration = takeover_acceleration;
1415 snapshot_.actual_velocity = takeover_velocity;
1416 snapshot_.actual_acceleration = takeover_acceleration;
1417 }
1418 if (command.buffer_mode == BufferMode::aborting)
1419 {
1420 const double relative_base = snapshot_.command_position;
1421 const double additive_base = takeover_status == AxisStatus::discrete_motion
1422 ? takeover_endpoint
1423 : snapshot_.command_position;
1424 command =
1425 normalize(command, command.kind == CommandKind::move_additive ? additive_base
1426 : relative_base);
1427 }
1428 if ((command.kind == CommandKind::move_absolute ||
1429 command.kind == CommandKind::move_continuous_absolute ||
1430 command.kind == CommandKind::home) &&
1431 !target_inside_limits(command.value))
1432 {
1433 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::out_of_range);
1434 }
1435
1436 if (command.buffer_mode == BufferMode::aborting || !active_)
1437 {
1438 const rt::ErrorCode started = start(command);
1439 if (started != rt::ErrorCode::ok)
1440 {
1441 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(started);
1442 }
1443 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::success(command.command_id);
1444 }
1445
1446 const rt::ErrorCode queued = queue_.push_back(command);
1447 if (queued != rt::ErrorCode::ok)
1448 {
1449 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(queued);
1450 }
1451 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::success(command.command_id);
1452 }
1453
1454 public:
1455 rt::Result<std::uint32_t> select_cam_table(const AxisModel *master,
1456 exec::CamTableView table,
1457 bool periodic,
1458 bool master_absolute,
1459 bool slave_absolute,
1460 std::uint32_t replace_id = 0)
1461 {
1462 table.periodic = periodic;
1463 if(master == nullptr || master == this || !table.valid() ||
1464 (!master_absolute && !table.periodic &&
1465 (table.points[0].master > 0.0 || table.points[table.size - 1].master < 0.0))) {
1466 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument);
1467 }
1468
1469 CamTableSelection *slot = nullptr;
1470 if(replace_id != 0) {
1471 for(CamTableSelection &selection : cam_table_selections_) {
1472 if(selection.id == replace_id) {
1473 slot = &selection;
1474 break;
1475 }
1476 }
1477 }
1478 if(slot == nullptr) {
1479 for(CamTableSelection &selection : cam_table_selections_) {
1480 if(selection.id == 0) {
1481 slot = &selection;
1482 break;
1483 }
1484 }
1485 }
1486 if(slot == nullptr) {
1487 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::capacity_exceeded);
1488 }
1489
1490 const std::uint32_t id = slot->id == 0 ? next_command_id_++ : slot->id;
1491 *slot = {id,
1492 master,
1493 table,
1494 master_absolute,
1495 slave_absolute,
1496 master->snapshot().command_position,
1497 snapshot_.command_position};
1498 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::success(id);
1499 }
1500
1501 rt::Result<CamTableSelection> cam_table_selection(std::uint32_t id) const
1502 {
1503 if(id == 0) {
1504 return rt::Result<CamTableSelection>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument);
1505 }
1506 for(const CamTableSelection &selection : cam_table_selections_) {
1507 if(selection.id == id) {
1508 return rt::Result<CamTableSelection>::success(selection);
1509 }
1510 }
1511 return rt::Result<CamTableSelection>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument);
1512 }
1513
1514 rt::Result<std::uint32_t> gear_in(const GearInCommand &command)
1515 {
1516 if (command.master == nullptr || command.master == this ||
1517 !std::isfinite(command.ratio_numerator) || !std::isfinite(command.ratio_denominator) ||
1518 command.ratio_denominator == 0.0 || !std::isfinite(command.master_sync_position) ||
1519 !std::isfinite(command.slave_sync_position) ||
1520 !std::isfinite(command.master_start_distance) ||
1521 !std::isfinite(command.approach_velocity) || command.approach_velocity < 0.0 ||
1522 !std::isfinite(command.acceleration) || command.acceleration < 0.0 ||
1523 !std::isfinite(command.deceleration) || command.deceleration < 0.0 ||
1524 !std::isfinite(command.jerk) || command.jerk < 0.0)
1525 {
1526 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument);
1527 }
1528 if (command.sync_mode != SyncMode::shortest &&
1529 command.sync_mode != SyncMode::catch_up &&
1530 command.sync_mode != SyncMode::slow_down)
1531 {
1532 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument);
1533 }
1534 if (command.position_sync && command.sync_mode != SyncMode::shortest)
1535 {
1536 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::unsupported);
1537 }
1538
1539 const rt::Result<std::uint32_t> begun = begin_sync(SyncKind::gear, command.buffer_mode);
1540 if (!begun)
1541 {
1542 return begun;
1543 }
1544 sync_gear_ = command;
1545 phase_offset_ = 0.0;
1546 abort_phasing_commands();
1547 sync_profile_ready_ = false;
1548 sync_entry_phase_ = command.position_sync ? SyncPhase::waiting_window : SyncPhase::approaching;
1549 if (sync_phase_ != SyncPhase::queued)
1550 {
1551 sync_phase_ = sync_entry_phase_;
1552 }
1553 return begun;
1554 }
1555
1556 rt::Result<std::uint32_t> cam_in(const CamInCommand &command)
1557 {
1558 if (command.master == nullptr || command.master == this || !command.table.valid() ||
1559 !std::isfinite(command.master_offset) || !std::isfinite(command.master_scaling) ||
1560 command.master_scaling == 0.0 || !std::isfinite(command.slave_offset) ||
1561 !std::isfinite(command.slave_scaling) || !std::isfinite(command.master_sync_position) ||
1562 !std::isfinite(command.master_start_distance) || command.master_start_distance < 0.0 ||
1563 !std::isfinite(command.approach_velocity) || command.approach_velocity < 0.0)
1564 {
1565 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument);
1566 }
1567
1568 // Approved cam matrix: the spline reconstruction happens at engage
1569 // in the planning domain; a failed build rejects before any state
1570 // changes.
1571 if (command.interpolation == exec::CamInterpolation::spline)
1572 {
1573 const rt::ErrorCode built = cam_spline_.build(command.table);
1574 if (built != rt::ErrorCode::ok)
1575 {
1576 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(built);
1577 }
1578 }
1579
1580 const rt::Result<std::uint32_t> begun = begin_sync(SyncKind::cam, command.buffer_mode);
1581 if (!begun)
1582 {
1583 return begun;
1584 }
1585 sync_cam_ = command;
1586 sync_entry_phase_ =
1587 command.master_start_distance > 0.0 ? SyncPhase::waiting_window : SyncPhase::engaged;
1588 if (sync_phase_ != SyncPhase::queued)
1589 {
1590 sync_phase_ = sync_entry_phase_;
1591 }
1592 return begun;
1593 }
1594
1595 rt::Result<std::uint32_t> combine_in(const CombineAxesCommand &command)
1596 {
1597 if (command.master1 == nullptr || command.master2 == nullptr || command.master1 == this ||
1598 command.master2 == this || !std::isfinite(command.ratio_numerator_m1) ||
1599 !std::isfinite(command.ratio_denominator_m1) || command.ratio_denominator_m1 == 0.0 ||
1600 !std::isfinite(command.ratio_numerator_m2) ||
1601 !std::isfinite(command.ratio_denominator_m2) || command.ratio_denominator_m2 == 0.0)
1602 {
1603 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument);
1604 }
1605
1606 const rt::Result<std::uint32_t> begun = begin_sync(SyncKind::combine, command.buffer_mode);
1607 if (!begun)
1608 {
1609 return begun;
1610 }
1611 sync_combine_ = command;
1612 sync_entry_phase_ = SyncPhase::engaged;
1613 if (sync_phase_ != SyncPhase::queued)
1614 {
1615 sync_phase_ = sync_entry_phase_;
1616 }
1617 return begun;
1618 }
1619
1620 // Approved cam matrix (decision #5): online table switch on an engaged
1621 // cam. The new geometry must agree with the current slave position at
1622 // the current master input (within tolerance); velocity/acceleration may
1623 // jump within the declared boundary — the slave rides the new table from
1624 // the next cycle. The engagement phase, sync id, and master stay.
1625 rt::ErrorCode cam_switch(const CamInCommand &command, double tolerance)
1626 {
1627 if (sync_kind_ != SyncKind::cam || sync_phase_ != SyncPhase::engaged ||
1628 command.master != sync_cam_.master || !command.table.valid() ||
1629 !std::isfinite(tolerance) || tolerance < 0.0 || command.master_start_distance != 0.0 ||
1630 !std::isfinite(command.master_offset) || !std::isfinite(command.master_scaling) ||
1631 command.master_scaling == 0.0 || !std::isfinite(command.slave_offset) ||
1632 !std::isfinite(command.slave_scaling))
1633 {
1634 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
1635 }
1636
1637 exec::CamSpline replacement{};
1638 if (command.interpolation == exec::CamInterpolation::spline)
1639 {
1640 const rt::ErrorCode built = replacement.build(command.table);
1641 if (built != rt::ErrorCode::ok)
1642 {
1643 return built;
1644 }
1645 }
1646
1647 const double master_position = master_value(*sync_cam_.master, sync_cam_.source);
1648 const double table_input =
1649 (master_position - command.master_offset) / command.master_scaling;
1650 const rt::Result<double> sampled = command.interpolation == exec::CamInterpolation::spline
1651 ? replacement.sample(table_input)
1652 : command.table.sample(table_input);
1653 if (!sampled)
1654 {
1655 return sampled.error();
1656 }
1657 const double replacement_slave =
1658 command.slave_offset + command.slave_scaling * sampled.value();
1659 const rt::Result<double> current = cam_slave_value(master_position);
1660 if (!current)
1661 {
1662 return current.error();
1663 }
1664 if (std::fabs(replacement_slave - current.value()) > tolerance)
1665 {
1666 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
1667 }
1668
1669 sync_cam_.table = command.table;
1670 sync_cam_.interpolation = command.interpolation;
1671 sync_cam_.master_offset = command.master_offset;
1672 sync_cam_.master_scaling = command.master_scaling;
1673 sync_cam_.slave_offset = command.slave_offset;
1674 sync_cam_.slave_scaling = command.slave_scaling;
1675 if (command.interpolation == exec::CamInterpolation::spline)
1676 {
1677 cam_spline_ = replacement;
1678 }
1679 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1680 }
1681
1682 rt::ErrorCode gear_update(double ratio_numerator, double ratio_denominator)
1683 {
1684 if (sync_kind_ != SyncKind::gear || !std::isfinite(ratio_numerator) ||
1685 !std::isfinite(ratio_denominator) || ratio_denominator == 0.0)
1686 {
1687 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
1688 }
1689 sync_gear_.ratio_numerator = ratio_numerator;
1690 sync_gear_.ratio_denominator = ratio_denominator;
1691 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1692 }
1693
1694 rt::ErrorCode cam_update(double master_offset, double master_scaling, double slave_offset,
1695 double slave_scaling)
1696 {
1697 if (sync_kind_ != SyncKind::cam || !std::isfinite(master_offset) ||
1698 !std::isfinite(master_scaling) || master_scaling == 0.0 ||
1699 !std::isfinite(slave_offset) || !std::isfinite(slave_scaling))
1700 {
1701 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
1702 }
1703 sync_cam_.master_offset = master_offset;
1704 sync_cam_.master_scaling = master_scaling;
1705 sync_cam_.slave_offset = slave_offset;
1706 sync_cam_.slave_scaling = slave_scaling;
1707 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1708 }

1710 rt::ErrorCode combine_update(CombineMode mode, double ratio_numerator_m1,
1711 double ratio_denominator_m1, double ratio_numerator_m2,
1712 double ratio_denominator_m2)
1713 {
1714 if (sync_kind_ != SyncKind::combine || !std::isfinite(ratio_numerator_m1) ||
1715 !std::isfinite(ratio_denominator_m1) || ratio_denominator_m1 == 0.0 ||
1716 !std::isfinite(ratio_numerator_m2) || !std::isfinite(ratio_denominator_m2) ||
1717 ratio_denominator_m2 == 0.0)
1718 {
1719 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
1720 }

1722 sync_combine_.ratio_numerator_m1 = ratio_numerator_m1;
1723 sync_combine_.ratio_denominator_m1 = ratio_denominator_m1;
1724 sync_combine_.ratio_numerator_m2 = ratio_numerator_m2;
1725 sync_combine_.ratio_denominator_m2 = ratio_denominator_m2;
1726 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1727 }
1728
1729 rt::ErrorCode sync_out()
1730 {
1731 if (sync_kind_ == SyncKind::none)
1732 {
1733 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
1734 }
1735 const double velocity = snapshot_.command_velocity;
1736 reset_sync();
1737 snapshot_.active_command_id = 0;
1738 if (velocity != 0.0 && snapshot_.powered)
1739 {
1740 AxisCommand hold{};
1741 hold.kind = CommandKind::move_velocity;
1742 hold.value = velocity < 0.0 ? -1.0 : 1.0;
1743 hold.velocity = std::fabs(velocity);
1744 hold.command_id = next_command_id_++;
1745 start(hold);
1746 }
1747 else
1748 {
1749 snapshot_.status = snapshot_.powered ? AxisStatus::standstill : AxisStatus::disabled;
1750 snapshot_.command_velocity = 0.0;
1751 snapshot_.actual_velocity = 0.0;
1752 }
1753 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1754 }
1755
1756 // B9 stream session (approved trajectory-stream matrix, decisions #9/#10).
1757 // Engaging is an aborting-class takeover: the filter starts from the
1758 // current kinematic state (no jump; a moving entry arms the filter's
1759 // controlled-stop ladder until the first target). Undefined combinations
1760 // are explicit errors: no engage while unpowered, in errorstop, gear/cam/
1761 // combine-synchronized, group-owned, or already streaming; axis software
1762 // position limits are not auto-applied — wire them through the filter
1763 // envelope in the config.
1764 rt::Result<std::uint32_t> stream_engage(const stream::StreamFilterConfig &config)
1765 {
1766 if (!snapshot_.powered || snapshot_.status == AxisStatus::errorstop ||
1767 sync_kind_ != SyncKind::none || stream_active_ || group_owner_ != nullptr)
1768 {
1769 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument);
1770 }
1771 const rt::ErrorCode configured = stream_filter_.configure(config);
1772 if (configured != rt::ErrorCode::ok)
1773 {
1774 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(configured);
1775 }
1776
1777 // Aborting takeovers keep kinematic continuity (KB-026 pattern):
1778 // abort_motion() zeroes the command velocity/acceleration, but the
1779 // filter must start from the state the axis was actually in.
1780 const double takeover_velocity = snapshot_.command_velocity;
1781 const double takeover_acceleration = snapshot_.command_acceleration;
1782 abort_motion();
1783 snapshot_.command_velocity = takeover_velocity;
1784 snapshot_.actual_velocity = takeover_velocity;
1785 snapshot_.command_acceleration = takeover_acceleration;
1786 snapshot_.actual_acceleration = takeover_acceleration;
1787
1788 const rt::ErrorCode reset = stream_filter_.reset(
1789 {snapshot_.command_position, takeover_velocity, takeover_acceleration});
1790 if (reset != rt::ErrorCode::ok)
1791 {
1792 snapshot_.command_velocity = 0.0;
1793 snapshot_.actual_velocity = 0.0;
1794 snapshot_.command_acceleration = 0.0;
1795 snapshot_.actual_acceleration = 0.0;
1796 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(reset);
1797 }
1798 stream_active_ = true;
1799 stream_id_ = next_command_id_++;
1800 snapshot_.status = AxisStatus::synchronized_motion;
1801 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::success(stream_id_);
1802 }
1803
1804 rt::ErrorCode stream_push(const stream::StreamTarget &target)
1805 {
1806 if (!stream_active_)
1807 {
1808 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
1809 }
1810 return stream_filter_.push_target(target);
1811 }
1812
1813 // Graceful exit is only defined at rest; a moving session exits through
1814 // a standard aborting command (MC_Halt/MC_Stop/motion takeover).
1815 rt::ErrorCode stream_disengage()
1816 {
1817 if (!stream_active_)
1818 {
1819 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
1820 }
1821 if (snapshot_.command_velocity != 0.0 || snapshot_.command_acceleration != 0.0)
1822 {
1823 return rt::ErrorCode::precondition_failed;
1824 }
1825 stream_filter_.end_session();
1826 stream_active_ = false;
1827 stream_id_ = 0;
1828 snapshot_.status = snapshot_.powered ? AxisStatus::standstill : AxisStatus::disabled;
1829 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1830 }
1831
1832 std::uint32_t stream_session_id() const { return stream_id_; }
1833
1834 // Read-only session introspection (mode, counters, clamped flag); only
1835 // meaningful while the session is engaged.
1836 const stream::StreamFilter1D &stream_filter() const { return stream_filter_; }
1837
1838 SyncPhase sync_phase() const { return sync_phase_; }
1839
1840 std::uint32_t sync_command_id() const { return sync_id_; }
1841
1842 double gear_phase_offset() const { return phase_offset_; }
1843
1844 bool phasing_active() const { return phasing_active_; }
1845
1846 PhasingCommandState phasing_command_state(std::uint32_t command_id) const
1847 {
1848 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < phasing_result_count_; ++i)
1849 {
1850 const std::size_t index =
1851 (phasing_result_cursor_ + PhasingResultCapacity - 1 - i) % PhasingResultCapacity;
1852 if (phasing_results_[index].command_id == command_id)
1853 {
1854 return phasing_results_[index].state;
1855 }
1856 }
1857 return PhasingCommandState::unknown;
1858 }
1859
1860 double phasing_covered_shift(std::uint32_t command_id) const
1861 {
1862 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < phasing_result_count_; ++i)
1863 {
1864 const std::size_t index =
1865 (phasing_result_cursor_ + PhasingResultCapacity - 1 - i) % PhasingResultCapacity;
1866 if (phasing_results_[index].command_id == command_id)
1867 {
1868 return phasing_results_[index].covered_shift;
1869 }
1870 }
1871 return 0.0;
1872 }
1873
1874 bool gear_engaged_with(const AxisModel *master) const
1875 {
1876 return master != nullptr && sync_kind_ == SyncKind::gear &&
1877 sync_phase_ == SyncPhase::engaged && sync_gear_.master == master;
1878 }
1879
1880 rt::Result<std::uint32_t> submit_phasing(PhasingCommand command)
1881 {
1882 if (sync_kind_ != SyncKind::gear || sync_phase_ != SyncPhase::engaged ||
1883 !std::isfinite(command.phase_shift) || !std::isfinite(command.velocity) ||
1884 !std::isfinite(command.acceleration) || !std::isfinite(command.deceleration) ||
1885 !std::isfinite(command.jerk) || command.velocity < 0.0 ||
1886 command.acceleration < 0.0 || command.deceleration < 0.0 || command.jerk < 0.0)
1887 {
1888 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument);
1889 }
1890 if (command.buffer_mode != BufferMode::aborting &&
1891 command.buffer_mode != BufferMode::buffered)
1892 {
1893 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::unsupported);
1894 }
1895 const bool direct = command.velocity == 0.0;
1896 if ((direct && (command.acceleration != 0.0 || command.deceleration != 0.0 ||
1897 command.jerk != 0.0)) ||
1898 (!direct && (command.acceleration <= 0.0 || command.deceleration <= 0.0 ||
1899 command.jerk <= 0.0)))
1900 {
1901 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument);
1902 }
1903 if (command.buffer_mode == BufferMode::buffered &&
1904 phasing_active_ && phasing_queue_.size() >= QueueCapacity)
1905 {
1906 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::capacity_exceeded);
1907 }
1908 if (command.buffer_mode == BufferMode::aborting && !direct)
1909 {
1910 const double target = command.relative ? phase_offset_ + command.phase_shift
1911 : command.phase_shift;
1912 if (target != phase_offset_)
1913 {
1914 const otg::Limits1D limits{command.velocity, command.acceleration,
1915 command.deceleration, command.jerk};
1916 const rt::Result<otg::Profile1D> preflight = otg::plan_time_optimal(
1917 {phase_offset_, phasing_velocity_, phasing_acceleration_},
1918 {target, 0.0, 0.0}, limits);
1919 if (!preflight)
1920 {
1921 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(preflight.error());
1922 }
1923 }
1924 }
1925
1926 command.command_id = next_command_id_++;
1927 remember_phasing(command.command_id, PhasingCommandState::queued, 0.0);
1928 if (command.buffer_mode == BufferMode::aborting)
1929 {
1930 abort_phasing_commands(true);
1931 remember_phasing(command.command_id, PhasingCommandState::queued, 0.0);
1932 }
1933 if (phasing_active_)
1934 {
1935 const rt::ErrorCode queued = phasing_queue_.push_back(command);
1936 if (queued != rt::ErrorCode::ok)
1937 {
1938 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(queued);
1939 }
1940 }
1941 else
1942 {
1943 const rt::ErrorCode started = start_phasing(command);
1944 if (started != rt::ErrorCode::ok)
1945 {
1946 remember_phasing(command.command_id, PhasingCommandState::aborted, 0.0);
1947 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(started);
1948 }
1949 }
1950 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::success(command.command_id);
1951 }
1952
1953 // Adapter hook: inject measured feedback without touching command state.
1954 rt::ErrorCode set_actual_feedback(double position, double velocity, double acceleration = 0.0,
1955 double torque = 0.0)
1956 {
1957 if (!std::isfinite(position) || !std::isfinite(velocity) || !std::isfinite(acceleration) ||
1958 !std::isfinite(torque))
1959 {
1960 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
1961 }
1962 snapshot_.actual_position = position;
1963 snapshot_.actual_velocity = velocity;
1964 snapshot_.actual_acceleration = acceleration;
1965 snapshot_.actual_torque = torque;
1966 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1967 }

1969 // MC_Home direct mode: remap the coordinate and mark the axis homed.
1970 rt::ErrorCode home_direct(double position)
1971 {
1972 if (!std::isfinite(position) || homing_step_precondition() != rt::ErrorCode::ok)
1973 {
1974 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
1975 }
1976 abort_motion();
1977 snapshot_.status = snapshot_.powered ? AxisStatus::standstill : AxisStatus::disabled;
1978 const rt::ErrorCode set = set_position(position);
1979 if (set != rt::ErrorCode::ok)
1980 {
1981 return set;
1982 }
1983 snapshot_.homed = true;
1984 homing_limits_suspended_ = false;
1985 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
1986 }
1987
1988 // Part 5 homed lifecycle: accepted Step FBs clear, FinishHoming sets.
1989 void clear_homed()
1990 {
1991 snapshot_.homed = false;
1992 homing_limits_suspended_ = true;
1993 }
1994
1995 void set_homed()
1996 {
1997 snapshot_.homed = true;
1998 homing_limits_suspended_ = false;
1999 }
2000
2001 void finish_homing()
2002 {
2003 set_homed();
2004 if (!has_standalone_motion() && snapshot_.status == AxisStatus::homing)
2005 {
2006 snapshot_.status = snapshot_.powered ? AxisStatus::standstill : AxisStatus::disabled;
2007 }
2008 }
2009
2010 rt::ErrorCode finish_homing_now()
2011 {
2012 if (homing_step_precondition() != rt::ErrorCode::ok)
2013 {
2014 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
2015 }
2016 abort_motion();
2017 set_homed();
2018 snapshot_.status = snapshot_.powered ? AxisStatus::standstill : AxisStatus::disabled;
2019 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
2020 }
2021
2022 // Digital IO banks. Adapters feed input levels through set_digital_input
2023 // and consume outputs written by the IO function blocks. The touch-probe
2024 // trigger channels are these digital inputs (v0.x Servo extension channel
2025 // semantics); probes capture on the rising edge evaluated inside cycle().
2026 // An input that is already high when the probe arms does not capture until
2027 // a fresh edge.
2028 static constexpr std::size_t DigitalInputCount = 4;
2029 static constexpr std::size_t DigitalOutputCount = 4;
2030
2031 rt::ErrorCode set_digital_input(std::size_t input, bool level)
2032 {
2033 if (input >= DigitalInputCount)
2034 {
2035 return rt::ErrorCode::unsupported;
2036 }
2037 digital_input_[input] = level;
2038 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
2039 }
2040
2041 rt::Result<bool> digital_input(std::size_t input) const
2042 {
2043 if (input >= DigitalInputCount)
2044 {

2085 rt::Result<std::uint32_t> arm_touch_probe(std::size_t input, bool window_only,
2086 double first_position, double last_position)
2087 {
2088 if (input >= DigitalInputCount)
2089 {
2090 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::unsupported);
2091 }
2092 if (window_only && (!std::isfinite(first_position) || !std::isfinite(last_position) ||
2093 first_position > last_position))
2094 {
2095 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument);
2096 }
2097 ProbeSlot &slot = probes_[input];
2098 slot.armed = true;
2099 slot.captured = false;
2100 slot.window_only = window_only;
2101 slot.first_position = first_position;
2102 slot.last_position = last_position;
2103 slot.recorded_position = 0.0;
2104 slot.last_level = digital_input_[input];
2105 slot.command_id = next_command_id_++;
2106 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::success(slot.command_id);
2107 }
2108
2109 // Disarming an idle input is not an error (matches the v0.x boundary).
2110 rt::ErrorCode abort_trigger(std::size_t input)
2111 {
2112 if (input >= DigitalInputCount)
2113 {
2114 return rt::ErrorCode::unsupported;
2115 }
2116 probes_[input].armed = false;
2117 probes_[input].captured = false;
2118 probes_[input].command_id = 0;
2119 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
2120 }
2121
2122 std::uint32_t probe_command_id(std::size_t input) const
2123 {
2124 return input < DigitalInputCount ? probes_[input].command_id : 0;
2125 }
2126
2127 rt::Result<std::uint32_t> begin_passive_homing(std::size_t input)
2128 {
2129 if (!active_ || input >= DigitalInputCount || sync_kind_ != SyncKind::none ||
2130 stream_active_ || superimposed_active_ || group_blocks_standalone_motion())
2131 {
2132 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::precondition_failed);
2133 }
2134 if (passive_homing_id_ != 0)
2135 {
2136 passive_homing_aborted_id_ = passive_homing_id_;
2137 abort_trigger(passive_homing_input_);
2138 }
2139 const rt::Result<std::uint32_t> armed = arm_touch_probe(input, false, 0.0, 0.0);
2140 if (!armed)
2141 return armed;
2142 passive_homing_id_ = armed.value();
2143 passive_homing_input_ = input;
2144 return armed;
2145 }
2146
2147 rt::ErrorCode finish_passive_homing(std::uint32_t owner)
2148 {
2149 if (owner == 0 || passive_homing_id_ != owner)
2150 {
2151 return rt::ErrorCode::precondition_failed;
2152 }
2153 passive_homing_id_ = 0;
2154 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
2155 }
2156
2157 rt::Result<std::uint32_t> abort_passive_homing()
2158 {
2159 if (passive_homing_id_ == 0)
2160 {
2161 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::precondition_failed);
2162 }
2163 const std::uint32_t owner = passive_homing_id_;
2164 abort_trigger(passive_homing_input_);
2165 passive_homing_aborted_id_ = owner;
2166 passive_homing_id_ = 0;
2167 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::success(owner);
2168 }
2169
2170 std::uint32_t passive_homing_id() const { return passive_homing_id_; }
2171 std::uint32_t passive_homing_aborted_id() const { return passive_homing_aborted_id_; }
2172
2173 bool probe_captured(std::size_t input) const
2174 {
2175 return input < DigitalInputCount && probes_[input].captured;
2176 }

2178 double probe_recorded_position(std::size_t input) const

2183 void cycle()
2184 {
2185 if (snapshot_.status == AxisStatus::errorstop)
2186 {
2187 return;
2188 }
2189 if(!has_standalone_motion())
2190 {
2191 cycle_management();
2192 }
2193 if (stream_cycle())
2194 {
2195 cycle_probes();
2196 return;
2197 }
2198 if (sync_cycle())
2199 {
2200 cycle_probes();
2201 return;
2202 }
2203 cycle_base_motion();
2204 cycle_superimposed();
2205 cycle_probes();
2206 }
2207
2208 // Independent offset profile on top of the base motion (MC_MoveSuperimposed).
2209 rt::Result<std::uint32_t> submit_superimposed(double distance, double velocity,
2210 double acceleration, double deceleration,
2211 double jerk)
2212 {
2213 if (group_blocks_standalone_motion() || !snapshot_.powered ||
2214 snapshot_.status == AxisStatus::errorstop || sync_kind_ != SyncKind::none ||
2215 stream_active_ || !std::isfinite(distance) || !std::isfinite(velocity) ||
2216 velocity <= 0.0 || !std::isfinite(acceleration) || acceleration <= 0.0 ||
2217 !std::isfinite(deceleration) || deceleration <= 0.0 || !std::isfinite(jerk) ||
2218 jerk <= 0.0 || !direction_enabled(distance))
2219 {
2220 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument);
2221 }
2222
2223 const otg::Limits1D limits =
2224 scaled_limits(velocity, acceleration, deceleration, jerk);
2225 const rt::Result<otg::Profile1D> profile =
2226 otg::plan_time_optimal({0.0, 0.0, 0.0}, {distance, 0.0, 0.0}, limits);
2227 if (!profile)
2228 {
2229 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(profile.error());
2230 }
2231
2232 superimposed_profile_ = profile.value();
2233 superimposed_tick_ = 0;
2234 superimposed_last_ = 0.0;
2235 superimposed_active_ = true;
2236 superimposed_halting_ = false;
2237 superimposed_id_ = next_command_id_++;
2238 superimposed_completed_id_ = 0;
2239 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::success(superimposed_id_);
2240 }
2241
2242 // Stops only the superimposed offset; the base command keeps running. The
2243 // contribution accumulated so far persists in the command position.
2244 rt::ErrorCode halt_superimposed(double deceleration, double jerk)
2245 {
2246 if (!snapshot_.powered || snapshot_.status == AxisStatus::errorstop ||
2247 !std::isfinite(deceleration) || deceleration <= 0.0 ||
2248 !std::isfinite(jerk) || jerk <= 0.0)
2249 {
2250 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
2251 }
2252 if (!superimposed_active_)
2253 {
2254 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
2255 }
2256
2257 const otg::State1D current = otg::sample(
2258 superimposed_profile_, rt::CycleTick::from_cycles(superimposed_tick_));
2259 if (current.velocity == 0.0 && current.acceleration == 0.0)
2260 {
2261 superimposed_active_ = false;
2262 superimposed_id_ = 0;
2263 superimposed_halting_ = false;
2264 superimposed_completed_id_ = 0;
2265 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
2266 }
2267
2268 double brake_velocity = current.velocity;
2269 double brake_shift = 0.0;
2270 if (current.acceleration != 0.0)
2271 {
2272 const double zero_cycles =
2273 std::ceil(std::fabs(current.acceleration) / jerk);
2274 brake_velocity += 0.5 * current.acceleration * zero_cycles;
2275 brake_shift += current.velocity * zero_cycles +
2276 current.acceleration * zero_cycles * zero_cycles / 3.0;
2277 }
2278 const otg::Limits1D halt_limits{
2279 std::fabs(current.velocity) + std::fabs(brake_velocity) + 1e-9,
2280 std::fmax(std::fabs(current.acceleration), deceleration),
2281 deceleration, jerk};
2282 const double stop_position = current.position + brake_shift +
2283 otg::detail::ramp_between(brake_velocity, 0.0, halt_limits).distance;
2284 const rt::Result<otg::Profile1D> halt = otg::plan_time_optimal(
2285 current, {stop_position, 0.0, 0.0}, halt_limits);
2286 if (!halt)
2287 {
2288 return halt.error();
2289 }
2290 superimposed_profile_ = halt.value();
2291 superimposed_tick_ = 0;
2292 superimposed_last_ = current.position;
2293 superimposed_halting_ = true;
2294 superimposed_completed_id_ = 0;
2295 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
2296 }
2297
2298 void abort_superimposed()
2299 {
2300 superimposed_active_ = false;
2301 superimposed_id_ = 0;
2302 superimposed_completed_id_ = 0;
2303 superimposed_halting_ = false;
2304 }

2306 bool superimposed_active() const { return superimposed_active_; }
2307
2308 std::uint32_t superimposed_command_id() const { return superimposed_id_; }
2309
2310 std::uint32_t superimposed_completed_id() const { return superimposed_completed_id_; }
2311
2312 double superimposed_distance() const { return superimposed_last_; }
2313
2314 rt::ErrorCode update_superimposed_target(std::uint32_t command_id,
2315 double distance,
2316 double velocity,
2317 double acceleration,
2318 double deceleration,
2319 double jerk)
2320 {
2321 if(!superimposed_active_ || superimposed_halting_ || command_id == 0 ||
2322 command_id != superimposed_id_ || !std::isfinite(distance) ||
2323 !std::isfinite(velocity) || velocity <= 0.0 ||
2324 !std::isfinite(acceleration) || acceleration <= 0.0 ||
2325 !std::isfinite(deceleration) || deceleration <= 0.0 ||
2326 !std::isfinite(jerk) || jerk <= 0.0 ||
2327 !direction_enabled(distance - superimposed_last_))
2328 {
2329 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
2330 }
2331 const otg::State1D current = otg::sample(
2332 superimposed_profile_, rt::CycleTick::from_cycles(superimposed_tick_));
2333 const rt::Result<otg::Profile1D> profile = otg::plan_time_optimal(
2334 current, {distance, 0.0, 0.0},
2335 scaled_limits(velocity, acceleration, deceleration, jerk));
2336 if(!profile)
2337 {
2338 return profile.error();
2339 }
2340 superimposed_profile_ = profile.value();
2341 superimposed_tick_ = 0;
2342 superimposed_last_ = current.position;
2343 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
2344 }

2346 // True while the command sits in the buffered queue (facades report Busy
2347 // for queued successors instead of misreading them as aborted).
2348 bool command_pending(std::uint32_t command_id) const
2349 {
2350 if (command_id == 0)
2351 {
2352 return false;
2353 }
2354 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < queue_.size(); ++i)
2355 {
2356 if (queue_[i].command_id == command_id)
2357 {
2358 return true;
2359 }
2360 }
2361 return false;
2362 }
2363
2364 bool management_command_pending(std::uint32_t command_id) const
2365 {
2366 if(command_id == 0) return false;
2367 for(std::size_t i = 0; i < management_queue_.size(); ++i) {
2368 if(management_queue_[i].command_id == command_id) return true;
2369 }
2370 return false;
2371 }
2372
2373 bool management_command_active(std::uint32_t command_id) const
2374 {
2375 return command_id != 0 && active_management_id_ == command_id;
2376 }
2377
2378 bool management_command_done(std::uint32_t command_id) const
2379 {
2380 for(std::size_t i = 0; i < management_results_.size(); ++i) {
2381 if(management_results_[i].command_id == command_id) {
2382 return management_results_[i].error == rt::ErrorCode::ok;
2383 }
2384 }
2385 return false;
2386 }
2387
2388 rt::ErrorCode management_command_error(std::uint32_t command_id) const
2389 {
2390 for(std::size_t i = 0; i < management_results_.size(); ++i) {
2391 if(management_results_[i].command_id == command_id) {
2392 return management_results_[i].error;
2393 }
2394 }
2395 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
2396 }
2397
2398 rt::ErrorCode command_error(std::uint32_t command_id) const
2399 {
2400 if (command_id == 0)
2401 {
2402 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
2403 }
2404 for (std::size_t offset = 0; offset < command_error_count_; ++offset)
2405 {
2406 const std::size_t index =
2407 (command_error_cursor_ + CommandErrorCapacity - 1 - offset) % CommandErrorCapacity;
2408 if (command_errors_[index].command_id == command_id)
2409 {
2410 return command_errors_[index].error;
2411 }
2412 }
2413 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
2414 }
2415
2416 // A function-block-local runtime failure terminates only the owning
2417 // command. The first buffered successor takes over from the live state.
2418 rt::ErrorCode fail_command(std::uint32_t command_id, rt::ErrorCode code)
2419 {
2420 if (command_id == 0 || code == rt::ErrorCode::ok || !active_ ||
2421 snapshot_.active_command_id != command_id)
2422 {
2423 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
2424 }
2425 record_command_error(command_id, code);
2426 active_ = false;
2427 continuous_holding_ = false;
2428 override_braking_ = false;
2429 override_paused_ = false;
2430 blend_armed_ = false;
2431 snapshot_.active_command_id = 0;
2432 snapshot_.active_command_reached_target = false;
2433 snapshot_.command_acceleration = 0.0;
2434 snapshot_.actual_acceleration = 0.0;
2435 snapshot_.status = active_command_.homing ? AxisStatus::homing
2436 : (snapshot_.powered ? AxisStatus::standstill
2437 : AxisStatus::disabled);
2438 start_next_queued();
2439 if (!active_)
2440 {
2441 base_velocity_ = 0.0;
2442 snapshot_.command_velocity = 0.0;
2443 snapshot_.actual_velocity = 0.0;
2444 }
2445 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
2446 }

2448 std::uint32_t torque_command_id() const { return torque_command_id_; }

2451 {

2453 active_command_.kind == CommandKind::move_velocity &&
2454 std::fabs(snapshot_.command_velocity - signed_velocity(active_command_)) <= 1e-12;
2455 }

2457 bool command_in_end_velocity(std::uint32_t command_id) const
2458 {

2460 is_continuous_kind(active_command_.kind) &&
2461 snapshot_.active_command_reached_target &&
2462 std::fabs(snapshot_.command_velocity - continuous_hold_velocity_) <= 1e-12;
2463 }

2467 rt::ErrorCode release_stop(std::uint32_t command_id)
2468 {
2469 if (command_id == 0 || stop_lock_id_ != command_id)
2470 {
2471 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
2472 }
2473 if (active_ && snapshot_.active_command_id == command_id)
2474 {
2475 stop_release_requested_ = true;

2477 }
2478 stop_lock_id_ = 0;

2480 if (snapshot_.status == AxisStatus::stopping)
2481 {
2482 snapshot_.status = snapshot_.powered ? AxisStatus::standstill : AxisStatus::disabled;
2483 }

2487 // ContinuousUpdate for the active velocity command (MC_MoveVelocity,
2488 // KB-009): the new signed direction and magnitude apply from the next
2489 // cycle; the override keeps scaling per cycle.
2490 rt::ErrorCode update_active_velocity(std::uint32_t command_id, double direction_value,
2491 double velocity)
2492 {
2493 if (!active_ || snapshot_.active_command_id != command_id || command_id == 0 ||
2494 active_command_.kind != CommandKind::move_velocity || !std::isfinite(direction_value) ||
2495 !std::isfinite(velocity) || velocity <= 0.0 ||
2496 !direction_enabled(direction_value))
2497 {
2498 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
2499 }
2500 active_command_.value = direction_value;
2501 active_command_.velocity = velocity;
2502 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
2503 }
2504
2505 rt::ErrorCode update_active_torque(std::uint32_t command_id,
2506 const AxisCommand &command)
2507 {
2508 if(!active_ || snapshot_.active_command_id != command_id ||
2509 command_id == 0 || active_command_.kind != CommandKind::torque ||
2510 command.kind != CommandKind::torque || !is_finite_command(command) ||
2511 command.velocity < 0.0 || command.acceleration < 0.0 ||
2512 command.deceleration < 0.0 || command.jerk < 0.0 ||
2513 !is_valid_direction(command.direction) ||
2514 command.direction == Direction::shortest_way ||
2515 command.buffer_mode != BufferMode::aborting) {
2516 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
2517 }
2518 active_command_.value = command.value;
2519 active_command_.torque_ramp = command.torque_ramp;
2520 active_command_.velocity = command.velocity;
2521 active_command_.acceleration = command.acceleration;
2522 active_command_.deceleration = command.deceleration;
2523 active_command_.jerk = command.jerk;
2524 active_command_.direction = command.direction;
2525 snapshot_.torque_velocity_limit = command.velocity;
2526 snapshot_.torque_acceleration_limit = command.acceleration;
2527 snapshot_.torque_deceleration_limit = command.deceleration;
2528 snapshot_.torque_jerk_limit = command.jerk;
2529 snapshot_.torque_direction = command.direction;
2530 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
2531 }
2532
2533 // Retargets an active position command
2534 // (ContinuousUpdate).
2535 rt::ErrorCode update_active_target(std::uint32_t command_id, double target)
2536 {
2537 if (group_blocks_standalone_motion() || !active_ ||
2538 snapshot_.active_command_id != command_id || command_id == 0 ||
2539 !std::isfinite(target) ||
2540 (!is_continuous_kind(active_command_.kind) &&
2541 active_command_.kind != CommandKind::move_absolute &&
2542 active_command_.kind != CommandKind::move_relative &&
2543 active_command_.kind != CommandKind::move_additive))
2544 {
2545 return rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument;
2546 }
2547 if (!target_inside_limits(target))
2548 {
2549 return rt::ErrorCode::out_of_range;
2550 }
2551 if (!direction_enabled(target - snapshot_.command_position))
2552 {
2553 return rt::ErrorCode::precondition_failed;
2554 }
2555
2556 double end_velocity = 0.0;
2557 if (is_continuous_kind(active_command_.kind))
2558 {
2559 end_velocity = active_command_.end_velocity * override_;
2560 }
2561 const otg::Limits1D limits = scaled_limits(active_command_);
2562 const rt::Result<otg::Profile1D> profile =
2563 otg::plan_time_optimal({snapshot_.command_position, snapshot_.command_velocity,
2564 snapshot_.command_acceleration},
2565 {target, end_velocity, 0.0}, limits);
2566 if (!profile)
2567 {
2568 return profile.error();
2569 }
2570
2571 active_profile_ = profile.value();
2572 active_tick_ = 0;
2573 active_last_sample_ = snapshot_.command_position;
2574 active_target_ = target;
2575 active_command_.value = target;
2576 continuous_holding_ = false;
2577 continuous_hold_velocity_ = end_velocity;
2578 snapshot_.active_command_reached_target = false;
2579 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
2580 }

2582 private:
2583 void set_synchronized_position(double position) { set_synchronized_state(position, 0.0, 0.0); }
2584
2585 void set_synchronized_state(double position, double velocity, double acceleration)
2586 {
2587 snapshot_.status = AxisStatus::synchronized_motion;
2588 snapshot_.command_position = position;
2589 snapshot_.actual_position = position;
2590 snapshot_.command_velocity = velocity;
2591 snapshot_.actual_velocity = velocity;
2592 snapshot_.command_acceleration = acceleration;
2593 snapshot_.actual_acceleration = acceleration;
2594 }
2595
2596 void clear_synchronized()
2597 {
2598 reset_sync();
2599 if (snapshot_.status == AxisStatus::synchronized_motion)
2600 {
2601 snapshot_.status = snapshot_.powered ? AxisStatus::standstill : AxisStatus::disabled;
2602 }
2603 }
2604
2605 rt::Result<std::uint32_t> begin_sync(SyncKind kind, BufferMode buffer_mode)
2606 {
2607 // Synchronizing a streaming axis is undefined (approved stream
2608 // matrix, decision #10): explicit error, not a takeover.
2609 if (group_blocks_standalone_motion() || !snapshot_.powered ||
2610 snapshot_.status == AxisStatus::errorstop || stream_active_)
2611 {
2612 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument);
2613 }
2614 if (buffer_mode == BufferMode::aborting)
2615 {
2616 abort_motion();
2617 }
2618 else if (sync_kind_ != SyncKind::none)
2619 {
2620 // Re-synchronizing a synchronized axis is only defined as a takeover.
2621 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(rt::ErrorCode::invalid_argument);
2622 }
2623 // Synchronization owns the axis position; a running superimposed offset
2624 // cannot compose with it.
2625 reset_superimposed();
2626 sync_kind_ = kind;
2627 sync_id_ = next_command_id_++;
2628 sync_phase_ = active_ ? SyncPhase::queued : SyncPhase::idle;
2629 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::success(sync_id_);
2630 }
2631
2632 void reset_sync()
2633 {
2634 abort_phasing_commands();
2635 sync_kind_ = SyncKind::none;
2636 sync_phase_ = SyncPhase::idle;
2637 sync_entry_phase_ = SyncPhase::idle;
2638 sync_id_ = 0;
2639 phase_offset_ = 0.0;
2640 sync_profile_ready_ = false;
2641 }

2660 : sync_cam_.master_sync_position;

2675 // Slave setpoint at the moment the master crosses the sync position.
2676 rt::Result<double> sync_target_at_sync() const
2677 {
2678 if (sync_kind_ == SyncKind::gear)
2679 {
2680 return rt::Result<double>::success(sync_gear_.slave_sync_position);
2681 }
2682 return cam_slave_value(sync_master_sync_position());
