2684
2685 rt::Result<double> cam_slave_value(double master_position) const
2686 {
2687 const double table_input =
2688 (master_position - sync_cam_.master_offset) / sync_cam_.master_scaling;
2689 const rt::Result<double> sampled = sync_cam_.interpolation == exec::CamInterpolation::spline
2690 ? cam_spline_.sample(table_input)
2691 : sync_cam_.table.sample(table_input);
2692 if (!sampled)
2693 {
2694 return sampled;
2695 }
2696 return rt::Result<double>::success(sync_cam_.slave_offset +
2697 sync_cam_.slave_scaling * sampled.value());
2698 }
2699
2700 void remember_phasing(std::uint32_t command_id, PhasingCommandState state,
2701 double covered_shift)
2702 {
2703 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < phasing_result_count_; ++i)
2704 {
2705 const std::size_t index =
2706 (phasing_result_cursor_ + PhasingResultCapacity - 1 - i) % PhasingResultCapacity;
2707 if (phasing_results_[index].command_id == command_id)
2708 {
2709 phasing_results_[index].state = state;
2710 phasing_results_[index].covered_shift = covered_shift;
2711 return;
2712 }
2713 }
2714 phasing_results_[phasing_result_cursor_] = {command_id, state, covered_shift};
2715 phasing_result_cursor_ = (phasing_result_cursor_ + 1) % PhasingResultCapacity;
2716 if (phasing_result_count_ < PhasingResultCapacity)
2717 {
2718 ++phasing_result_count_;
2719 }
2720 }
2721
2722 void abort_phasing_commands(bool preserve_kinematics = false)
2723 {
2724 if (phasing_active_)
2725 {
2726 remember_phasing(phasing_id_, PhasingCommandState::aborted,
2727 phase_offset_ - phasing_start_offset_);
2728 }
2729 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < phasing_queue_.size(); ++i)
2730 {
2731 remember_phasing(phasing_queue_[i].command_id, PhasingCommandState::aborted, 0.0);
2732 }
2733 phasing_queue_.clear();
2734 phasing_active_ = false;
2735 phasing_id_ = 0;
2736 if (!preserve_kinematics)
2737 {
2738 phasing_velocity_ = 0.0;
2739 phasing_acceleration_ = 0.0;
2740 }
2741 phasing_tick_ = 0;
2742 }
2743
2744 rt::ErrorCode start_phasing(const PhasingCommand &command)
2745 {
2746 const double target = command.relative ? phase_offset_ + command.phase_shift
2747 : command.phase_shift;
2748 phasing_start_offset_ = phase_offset_;
2749 phasing_target_ = target;
2750 phasing_id_ = command.command_id;
2751 if (target == phase_offset_ || command.velocity == 0.0)
2752 {
2753 phase_offset_ = target;
2754 phasing_velocity_ = 0.0;
2755 phasing_acceleration_ = 0.0;
2756 phasing_active_ = false;
2757 remember_phasing(command.command_id, PhasingCommandState::completed,
2758 phase_offset_ - phasing_start_offset_);
2759 phasing_id_ = 0;
2760 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
2761 }
2762
2763 const otg::Limits1D limits{command.velocity, command.acceleration,
2764 command.deceleration, command.jerk};
2765 const rt::Result<otg::Profile1D> planned = otg::plan_time_optimal(
2766 {phase_offset_, phasing_velocity_, phasing_acceleration_}, {target, 0.0, 0.0}, limits);
2767 if (!planned)
2768 {
2769 phasing_id_ = 0;
2770 return planned.error();
2771 }
2772 phasing_profile_ = planned.value();
2773 phasing_tick_ = 0;
2774 phasing_active_ = true;
2775 remember_phasing(command.command_id, PhasingCommandState::active, 0.0);
2776 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
2777 }
2778
2779 void start_next_phasing()
2780 {
2781 while (!phasing_active_ && !phasing_queue_.empty())
2782 {
2783 const PhasingCommand next = phasing_queue_[0];
2784 for (std::size_t i = 1; i < phasing_queue_.size(); ++i)
2785 {
2786 phasing_queue_[i - 1] = phasing_queue_[i];
2787 }
2788 phasing_queue_.pop_back();
2789 const rt::ErrorCode started = start_phasing(next);
2790 if (started != rt::ErrorCode::ok)
2791 {
2792 remember_phasing(next.command_id, PhasingCommandState::aborted, 0.0);
2793 }
2794 }
2795 }
2796
2797 void advance_phasing()
2798 {
2799 if (!phasing_active_)
2800 {
2801 start_next_phasing();
2802 return;
2803 }
2804 ++phasing_tick_;
2805 const otg::State1D state =
2806 otg::sample(phasing_profile_, rt::CycleTick::from_cycles(phasing_tick_));
2807 phase_offset_ = state.position;
2808 phasing_velocity_ = state.velocity;
2809 phasing_acceleration_ = state.acceleration;
2810 remember_phasing(phasing_id_, PhasingCommandState::active,
2811 phase_offset_ - phasing_start_offset_);
2812 if (phasing_tick_ >= phasing_profile_.duration_cycles())
2813 {
2814 phase_offset_ = phasing_target_;
2815 phasing_velocity_ = 0.0;
2816 phasing_acceleration_ = 0.0;
2817 remember_phasing(phasing_id_, PhasingCommandState::completed,
2818 phase_offset_ - phasing_start_offset_);
2819 phasing_active_ = false;
2820 phasing_id_ = 0;
2821 start_next_phasing();
2822 }
2823 }
2824
2825 rt::Result<double> sync_engaged_position()
2826 {
2827 if (sync_kind_ == SyncKind::gear)
2828 {
2829 advance_phasing();
2830 const double master = master_value(*sync_gear_.master, sync_gear_.source);
2831 const double ratio = sync_gear_.ratio_numerator / sync_gear_.ratio_denominator;
2832 return rt::Result<double>::success(master * ratio + phase_offset_);
2833 }
2834 if (sync_kind_ == SyncKind::cam)
2835 {
2836 return cam_slave_value(master_value(*sync_cam_.master, sync_cam_.source));
2837 }
2838 const double master1 =
2839 master_value(*sync_combine_.master1, sync_combine_.source_m1) *
2840 (sync_combine_.ratio_numerator_m1 / sync_combine_.ratio_denominator_m1);
2841 const double master2 =
2842 master_value(*sync_combine_.master2, sync_combine_.source_m2) *
2843 (sync_combine_.ratio_numerator_m2 / sync_combine_.ratio_denominator_m2);
2844 return rt::Result<double>::success(
2845 sync_combine_.mode == CombineMode::sub_axes ? master1 - master2 : master1 + master2);
2846 }
2847
2848 double sync_engaged_velocity(double next_position) const
2849 {
2850 if (sync_kind_ == SyncKind::gear)
2851 {
2852 return master_velocity(*sync_gear_.master, sync_gear_.source) *
2853 (sync_gear_.ratio_numerator / sync_gear_.ratio_denominator);
2854 }
2855 if (sync_kind_ == SyncKind::combine)
2856 {
2857 const double master1 =
2858 master_velocity(*sync_combine_.master1, sync_combine_.source_m1) *
2859 (sync_combine_.ratio_numerator_m1 / sync_combine_.ratio_denominator_m1);
2860 const double master2 =
2861 master_velocity(*sync_combine_.master2, sync_combine_.source_m2) *
2862 (sync_combine_.ratio_numerator_m2 / sync_combine_.ratio_denominator_m2);
2863 return sync_combine_.mode == CombineMode::sub_axes ? master1 - master2
2864 : master1 + master2;
2865 }
2866 return next_position - snapshot_.command_position;
2867 }
2868
2869 otg::Limits1D gear_limits() const
2870 {
2871 const double ratio = sync_gear_.ratio_numerator / sync_gear_.ratio_denominator;
2872 const double target_velocity =
2873 master_velocity(*sync_gear_.master, sync_gear_.source) * ratio;
2874 const double velocity = sync_gear_.position_sync
2875 ? (sync_gear_.approach_velocity > 0.0
2876 ? sync_gear_.approach_velocity
2877 : limits_.max_velocity)
2878 : std::fmax(std::fabs(snapshot_.command_velocity),
2879 std::fabs(target_velocity)) + 1e-9;
2880 return {velocity,
2881 sync_gear_.acceleration > 0.0 ? sync_gear_.acceleration
2882 : limits_.max_acceleration,
2883 sync_gear_.deceleration > 0.0 ? sync_gear_.deceleration
2884 : limits_.max_deceleration,
2885 sync_gear_.jerk > 0.0 ? sync_gear_.jerk : limits_.max_jerk};
2886 }
2887
2888 rt::ErrorCode plan_gear_velocity_transition()
2889 {
2890 if (sync_gear_.acceleration == 0.0 && sync_gear_.deceleration == 0.0 &&
2891 sync_gear_.jerk == 0.0)
2892 {
2893 // The three optional dynamics inputs form one contract: all zero
2894 // selects unprofiled velocity locking, any nonzero value enables
2895 // the fully constrained engagement planner.
2896 sync_profile_ready_ = false;
2897 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
2898 }
2899 const double ratio = sync_gear_.ratio_numerator / sync_gear_.ratio_denominator;
2900 const double target_velocity =
2901 master_velocity(*sync_gear_.master, sync_gear_.source) * ratio;
2902 if (std::fabs(snapshot_.command_velocity - target_velocity) <= 1e-12 &&
2903 std::fabs(snapshot_.command_acceleration) <= 1e-12)
2904 {
2905 sync_profile_ready_ = false;
2906 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
2907 }
2908 const otg::Limits1D limits = gear_limits();
2909 const double ramp_distance =
2910 otg::detail::ramp_between(snapshot_.command_velocity, target_velocity, limits).distance;
2911 const rt::Result<otg::Profile1D> planned = otg::plan_time_optimal(
2912 {snapshot_.command_position, snapshot_.command_velocity,
2913 snapshot_.command_acceleration},
2914 {snapshot_.command_position + ramp_distance, target_velocity, 0.0}, limits);
2915 if (!planned)
2916 {
2917 return planned.error();
2918 }
2919 sync_profile_ = planned.value();
2920 sync_profile_tick_ = 0;
2921 sync_profile_target_velocity_ = target_velocity;
2922 sync_profile_ready_ = true;
2923 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
2924 }
2925
2926 int sync_window_direction() const
2927 {
2928 const double distance = sync_master_start_distance();
2929 if (distance > 0.0)
2930 return 1;
2931 if (distance < 0.0)
2932 return -1;
2933 const double velocity = sync_kind_ == SyncKind::gear
2934 ? master_velocity(*sync_gear_.master, sync_gear_.source)
2935 : master_velocity(*sync_cam_.master, sync_cam_.source);
2936 if (velocity > 0.0)
2937 return 1;
2938 if (velocity < 0.0)
2939 return -1;
2940 return sync_window_master_value() <= sync_master_sync_position() ? 1 : -1;
2941 }
2942
2943 bool sync_reached(double master, double boundary) const
2944 {
2945 return sync_window_direction() > 0 ? master >= boundary : master <= boundary;
2946 }
2947
2948 rt::ErrorCode plan_position_sync_profile()
2949 {
2950 const double master = sync_window_master_value();
2951 const double master_speed = sync_kind_ == SyncKind::gear
2952 ? master_velocity(*sync_gear_.master, sync_gear_.source)
2953 : master_velocity(*sync_cam_.master, sync_cam_.source);
2954 const double remaining = sync_master_sync_position() - master;
2955 if (remaining * master_speed <= 0.0)
2956 {
2957 return rt::ErrorCode::precondition_failed;
2958 }
2959 // The master setpoint is sampled before the slave in the same task.
2960 // One guard cycle keeps the fixed-time slave endpoint aligned with
2961 // the first cycle that observes the master crossing the sync point.
2962 const std::int64_t cycles = static_cast<std::int64_t>(
2963 std::ceil(std::fabs(remaining / master_speed))) + 1;
2964 const rt::Result<double> target = sync_target_at_sync();
2965 if (!target)
2966 {
2967 return target.error();
2968 }
2969 const double ratio = sync_gear_.ratio_numerator / sync_gear_.ratio_denominator;
2970 const double target_velocity = master_speed * ratio;
2971 const rt::Result<otg::Profile1D> planned = otg::solve_fixed_time(
2972 {snapshot_.command_position, snapshot_.command_velocity,
2973 snapshot_.command_acceleration},
2974 {target.value(), target_velocity, 0.0}, gear_limits(), cycles > 0 ? cycles : 1);
2975 if (!planned)
2976 {
2977 return planned.error();
2978 }
2979 sync_profile_ = planned.value();
2980 sync_profile_tick_ = 0;
2981 sync_profile_ready_ = true;
2982 approach_window_begin_ = sync_master_sync_position() - sync_master_start_distance();
2983 approach_start_slave_ = snapshot_.command_position;
2984 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
2985 }
2986
2987 void fail_sync_command(rt::ErrorCode code)
2988 {
2989 const std::uint32_t failed_id = sync_id_;
2990 reset_sync();
2991 record_command_error(failed_id, code);
2992 snapshot_.active_command_id = 0;
2993 snapshot_.command_velocity = 0.0;
2994 snapshot_.actual_velocity = 0.0;
2995 snapshot_.command_acceleration = 0.0;
2996 snapshot_.actual_acceleration = 0.0;
2997 snapshot_.status = snapshot_.powered ? AxisStatus::standstill : AxisStatus::disabled;
2998 }
2999
3000 void enter_engaged()
3001 {
3002 if (sync_kind_ == SyncKind::gear)
3003 {
3004 const double ratio = sync_gear_.ratio_numerator / sync_gear_.ratio_denominator;
3005 phase_offset_ = sync_gear_.position_sync
3006 ? sync_gear_.slave_sync_position -
3007 sync_gear_.master_sync_position * ratio
3008 : snapshot_.command_position -
3009 master_value(*sync_gear_.master, sync_gear_.source) * ratio;
3010 }
3011 sync_profile_ready_ = false;
3012 sync_phase_ = SyncPhase::engaged;
3013 snapshot_.active_command_id = sync_id_;
3014 snapshot_.status = AxisStatus::synchronized_motion;
3015 }
3016
3017 // Returns true when a stream session owns this cycle: the filter output
3018 // is the axis setpoint (the filter starts from the takeover state, so
3019 // the position domain is continuous with the pre-engage motion).
3020 bool stream_cycle()
3021 {
3022 if (!stream_active_)
3023 {
3024 return false;
3025 }
3026 const otg::State1D state = stream_filter_.cycle();
3027 snapshot_.command_position = state.position;
3028 snapshot_.actual_position = state.position;
3029 snapshot_.command_velocity = state.velocity;
3030 snapshot_.actual_velocity = state.velocity;
3031 snapshot_.command_acceleration = state.acceleration;
3032 snapshot_.actual_acceleration = state.acceleration;
3033 return true;
3034 }
3035
3036 // Returns true when synchronization owns this cycle (idle motion excluded).
3037 bool sync_cycle()
3038 {
3039 if (sync_kind_ == SyncKind::none)
3040 {
3041 return false;
3042 }
3043 if (sync_kind_ == SyncKind::group_path)
3044 {
3045 return true;
3046 }
3047 if (sync_phase_ == SyncPhase::queued)
3048 {
3049 if (active_)
3050 {
3051 return false;
3052 }
3053 sync_phase_ = sync_entry_phase_;
3054 }
3055
3056 if (sync_phase_ == SyncPhase::waiting_window)
3057 {
3058 const double master = sync_window_master_value();
3059 const double window_begin = sync_master_sync_position() - sync_master_start_distance();
3060 if (!sync_reached(master, window_begin))
3061 {
3062 return true;
3063 }
3064 if (!sync_reached(master, sync_master_sync_position()))
3065 {
3066 if (sync_kind_ == SyncKind::gear)
3067 {
3068 const rt::ErrorCode planned = plan_position_sync_profile();
3069 if (planned != rt::ErrorCode::ok)
3070 {
3071 fail_sync_command(planned);
3072 return true;
3073 }
3074 }
3075 else
3076 {
3077 approach_window_begin_ = window_begin;
3078 approach_start_slave_ = snapshot_.command_position;
3079 }
3080 sync_phase_ = SyncPhase::approaching;
3081 }
3082 else
3083 {
3084 enter_engaged();
3085 }
3086 }
3087
3088 if (sync_phase_ == SyncPhase::approaching)
3089 {
3090 if (sync_kind_ == SyncKind::gear && !sync_gear_.position_sync)
3091 {
3092 if (!sync_profile_ready_)
3093 {
3094 const rt::ErrorCode planned = plan_gear_velocity_transition();
3095 if (planned != rt::ErrorCode::ok)
3096 {
3097 fail_sync_command(planned);
3098 return true;
3099 }
3100 if (!sync_profile_ready_)
3101 {
3102 enter_engaged();
3103 return true;
3104 }
3105 }
3106 ++sync_profile_tick_;
3107 const otg::State1D state =
3108 otg::sample(sync_profile_, rt::CycleTick::from_cycles(sync_profile_tick_));
3109 snapshot_.active_command_id = sync_id_;
3110 set_synchronized_state(state.position, state.velocity, state.acceleration);
3111 if (sync_profile_tick_ >= sync_profile_.duration_cycles())
3112 {
3113 const double live_target =
3114 master_velocity(*sync_gear_.master, sync_gear_.source) *
3115 (sync_gear_.ratio_numerator / sync_gear_.ratio_denominator);
3116 sync_profile_ready_ = false;
3117 if (std::fabs(live_target - sync_profile_target_velocity_) <= 1e-12)
3118 {
3119 enter_engaged();
3120 }
3121 }
3122 return true;
3123 }
3124
3125 const double master = sync_window_master_value();
3126 if (sync_kind_ == SyncKind::gear && sync_gear_.position_sync)
3127 {
3128 if (sync_profile_tick_ < sync_profile_.duration_cycles())
3129 {
3130 ++sync_profile_tick_;
3131 const otg::State1D state = otg::sample(
3132 sync_profile_, rt::CycleTick::from_cycles(sync_profile_tick_));
3133 snapshot_.active_command_id = sync_id_;
3134 set_synchronized_state(state.position, state.velocity, state.acceleration);
3135 if (sync_profile_tick_ >= sync_profile_.duration_cycles())
3136 {
3137 if (!sync_reached(master, sync_master_sync_position()))
3138 {
3139 fail_sync_command(rt::ErrorCode::infeasible);
3140 }
3141 else
3142 {
3143 enter_engaged();
3144 }
3145 }
3146 return true;
3147 }
3148 if (!sync_reached(master, sync_master_sync_position()))
3149 {
3150 fail_sync_command(rt::ErrorCode::infeasible);
3151 return true;
3152 }
3153 enter_engaged();
3154 }
3155 else if (sync_reached(master, sync_master_sync_position()))
3156 {
3157 enter_engaged();
3158 }
3159 else
3160 {
3161 const rt::Result<double> target_at_sync = sync_target_at_sync();
3162 if (!target_at_sync)
3163 {
3164 trigger_error();
3165 return true;
3166 }
3167 const double span = sync_master_sync_position() - approach_window_begin_;
3168 double progress = span > 0.0 ? (master - approach_window_begin_) / span : 1.0;
3169 progress = progress < 0.0 ? 0.0 : (progress > 1.0 ? 1.0 : progress);
3170 double target = approach_start_slave_ +
3171 (target_at_sync.value() - approach_start_slave_) * progress;
3172 target = cap_approach_step(target);
3173 snapshot_.active_command_id = sync_id_;
3174 set_synchronized_position(target);
3175 return true;
3176 }
3177 }
3178
3179 if (sync_phase_ == SyncPhase::engaged)
3180 {
3181 const rt::Result<double> position = sync_engaged_position();
3182 if (!position)
3183 {
3184 trigger_error();
3185 return true;
3186 }
3187 snapshot_.active_command_id = sync_id_;
3188 const double velocity = sync_engaged_velocity(position.value());
3189 set_synchronized_state(position.value(), velocity,
3190 velocity - snapshot_.command_velocity);
3191 return true;
3192 }
3193 return true;
3194 }
3195
3196 double sync_window_master_value() const
3197 {
3198 return sync_kind_ == SyncKind::gear ? master_value(*sync_gear_.master, sync_gear_.source)
3199 : master_value(*sync_cam_.master, sync_cam_.source);
3200 }
3201
3202 double cap_approach_step(double target) const
3203 {
3204 const double cap = sync_approach_velocity();
3205 if (cap <= 0.0)
3206 {
3207 return target;
3208 }
3209 const double step = target - snapshot_.command_position;
3210 if (step > cap)
3211 {
3212 return snapshot_.command_position + cap;
3213 }
3214 if (step < -cap)
3215 {
3216 return snapshot_.command_position - cap;
3217 }
3218 return target;
3219 }
3220
3221 bool is_moving() const
3222 {
3223 return snapshot_.status == AxisStatus::discrete_motion ||
3224 snapshot_.status == AxisStatus::continuous_motion ||
3225 snapshot_.status == AxisStatus::synchronized_motion ||
3226 snapshot_.status == AxisStatus::stopping;
3227 }
3228
3229 double queued_endpoint() const
3230 {
3231 double endpoint = active_ ? active_target_ : snapshot_.command_position;
3232 for (std::size_t i = 0; i < queue_.size(); ++i)
3233 {
3234 const AxisCommand &queued = queue_[i];
3235 if (queued.kind == CommandKind::move_absolute ||
3236 queued.kind == CommandKind::move_continuous_absolute ||
3237 queued.kind == CommandKind::home)
3238 {
3239 endpoint = queued.value;
3240 }
3241 }
3242 return endpoint;
3243 }
3244
3245 AxisCommand normalize(AxisCommand command, double takeover_endpoint) const
3246 {
3247 if (command.kind == CommandKind::move_relative ||
3248 command.kind == CommandKind::move_additive)
3249 {
3250 command.value = takeover_endpoint + command.value;
3251 command.kind = CommandKind::move_absolute;
3252 }
3253 else if (command.kind == CommandKind::move_continuous_relative)
3254 {
3255 command.value = takeover_endpoint + command.value;
3256 command.kind = CommandKind::move_continuous_absolute;
3257 }
3258 return command;
3259 }
3260
3261 double signed_velocity(AxisCommand command) const
3262 {
3263 const double scaled = command.velocity * override_;
3264 return command.value < 0.0 ? -scaled : scaled;
3265 }
3266
3267 otg::Limits1D scaled_limits(double velocity, double acceleration,
3268 double deceleration, double jerk) const
3269 {
3270 return {velocity * override_, acceleration * acceleration_override_,
3271 deceleration * acceleration_override_, jerk * jerk_override_};
3272 }
3273
3274 otg::Limits1D scaled_limits(const AxisCommand &command) const
3275 {
3276 return scaled_limits(command.velocity, command.acceleration,
3277 command.deceleration, command.jerk);
3278 }
3279
3280 bool direction_enabled(double delta) const
3281 {
3282 return delta == 0.0 || (delta > 0.0 ? positive_enabled_ : negative_enabled_);
3283 }
3284
3285 bool command_direction_enabled(const AxisCommand &command,
3286 double reference_position) const
3287 {
3288 switch (command.kind)
3289 {
3290 case CommandKind::move_velocity:
3291 case CommandKind::torque:
3292 case CommandKind::move_relative:
3293 case CommandKind::move_additive:
3294 case CommandKind::move_continuous_relative:
3295 return direction_enabled(command.value);
3296 case CommandKind::move_absolute:
3297 case CommandKind::move_continuous_absolute:
3298 case CommandKind::home:
3299 return direction_enabled(command.value - reference_position);
3300 default:
3301 return true;
3302 }
3303 }
3304
3305 bool active_direction_enabled() const
3306 {
3307 if (!active_ && sync_kind_ == SyncKind::none && !stream_active_)
3308 {
3309 return true;
3310 }
3311 if (snapshot_.command_velocity != 0.0)
3312 {
3313 return direction_enabled(snapshot_.command_velocity);
3314 }
3315 return !active_ || command_direction_enabled(active_command_,
3316 snapshot_.command_position);
3317 }
3318
3319 bool target_inside_limits(double target, bool enforce_soft_limits = false) const
3320 {
3321 if (homing_limits_suspended_ && !enforce_soft_limits)
3322 {
3323 return true;
3324 }
3325 if (limits_.min_position_enabled && target < limits_.min_position)
3326 {
3327 return false;
3328 }
3329 if (limits_.max_position_enabled && target > limits_.max_position)
3330 {
3331 return false;
3332 }
3333 return true;
3334 }
3335
3336 rt::ErrorCode start(AxisCommand command)
3337 {
3338 if (command.kind == CommandKind::move_relative ||
3339 command.kind == CommandKind::move_additive ||
3340 command.kind == CommandKind::move_continuous_relative)
3341 {
3342 command = normalize(command, snapshot_.command_position);
3343 }
3344 active_command_ = command;
3345 active_tick_ = 0;
3346 continuous_holding_ = false;
3347 blend_armed_ = false;
3348 snapshot_.active_command_reached_target = false;
3349 snapshot_.active_command_id = command.command_id;
3350 snapshot_.command_torque_limit = command.torque_limit;
3351
3352 if (command.kind == CommandKind::move_velocity)
3353 {
3354 active_ = true;
3355 snapshot_.status = command.homing ? AxisStatus::homing : AxisStatus::continuous_motion;
3356 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
3357 }
3358
3359 if (command.kind == CommandKind::halt || command.kind == CommandKind::stop)
3360 {
3361 if (command.kind == CommandKind::stop && command.lock_stopping)
3362 {
3363 stop_lock_id_ = command.command_id;
3364 stop_release_requested_ = false;
3365 }
3366 // Controlled stop (MC_Halt/MC_Stop carry over the v0.x contract):
3367 // decelerate from the current state with the commanded
3368 // deceleration/jerk. The braking target is exempt from the
3369 // software position limits — the axis must be allowed to come to
3370 // rest. A resting axis still finishes within one cycle.
3371 halt_profiled_ = false;
3372 const double v0 = snapshot_.command_velocity;
3373 const double a0 = snapshot_.command_acceleration;
3374 if (v0 != 0.0 || a0 != 0.0)
3375 {
3376 double brake_velocity = v0;
3377 double brake_shift = 0.0;
3378 if (a0 != 0.0)
3379 {
3380 const double zero_cycles = std::ceil(std::fabs(a0) / command.jerk);
3381 brake_velocity += 0.5 * a0 * zero_cycles;
3382 brake_shift += v0 * zero_cycles + a0 * zero_cycles * zero_cycles / 3.0;
3383 }
3384 const otg::Limits1D halt_limits{
3385 std::fabs(v0) + std::fabs(brake_velocity) + 1e-9,
3386 std::fabs(a0) > command.acceleration ? std::fabs(a0) : command.acceleration,
3387 command.deceleration, command.jerk};
3388 const double stop_position =
3389 snapshot_.command_position + brake_shift +
3390 otg::detail::ramp_between(brake_velocity, 0.0, halt_limits).distance;
3391 const rt::Result<otg::Profile1D> halt = otg::plan_time_optimal(
3392 {snapshot_.command_position, v0, a0}, {stop_position, 0.0, 0.0}, halt_limits);
3393 if (halt)
3394 {
3395 active_profile_ = halt.value();
3396 active_last_sample_ = snapshot_.command_position;
3397 active_target_ = stop_position;
3398 halt_profiled_ = true;
3399 }
3400 }
3401 active_ = true;
3402 snapshot_.status = command.homing ? AxisStatus::homing : AxisStatus::stopping;
3403 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
3404 }
3405
3406 const double target = command.value;
3407 if (!target_inside_limits(target))
3408 {
3409 return rt::ErrorCode::out_of_range;
3410 }
3411
3412 double target_velocity = 0.0;
3413 if (is_continuous_kind(command.kind))
3414 {
3415 target_velocity = command.end_velocity * override_;
3416 }
3417
3418 active_target_ = target;
3419 const otg::Limits1D limits = scaled_limits(command);
3420 const rt::Result<otg::Profile1D> profile =
3421 otg::plan_time_optimal({snapshot_.command_position, snapshot_.command_velocity,
3422 snapshot_.command_acceleration},
3423 {target, target_velocity, 0.0}, limits);
3424 if (!profile)
3425 {
3426 return profile.error();
3427 }
3428
3429 active_profile_ = profile.value();
3430 active_last_sample_ = snapshot_.command_position;
3431 continuous_hold_velocity_ = target_velocity;
3432 active_ = true;
3433 snapshot_.status = command.homing
3434 ? AxisStatus::homing
3435 : (is_continuous_kind(command.kind) ? AxisStatus::continuous_motion
3436 : AxisStatus::discrete_motion);
3437 return rt::ErrorCode::ok;
3438 }

3440 void cycle_base_motion()
3441 {
3442 if (!active_)
3443 {
3444 return;
3445 }
3446
3447 if (override_paused_)
3448 {
3449 return;
3450 }
3451
3452 if (active_command_.kind == CommandKind::acceleration_profile)
3453 {
3454 if (!acceleration_profile_completed_)
3455 {
3456 const AxisCommand &segment = queue_[acceleration_segment_index_];
3457 const double acceleration = segment.value;
3458 snapshot_.command_acceleration = acceleration;
3459 snapshot_.actual_acceleration = acceleration;
3460 snapshot_.command_velocity += acceleration;
3461 snapshot_.actual_velocity = snapshot_.command_velocity;
3462 snapshot_.command_position += snapshot_.command_velocity;
3463 snapshot_.actual_position = snapshot_.command_position;
3464 base_velocity_ = snapshot_.command_velocity;
3465 ++acceleration_segment_tick_;
3466 if (acceleration_segment_tick_ >= segment.min_duration_cycles)
3467 {
3468 acceleration_segment_tick_ = 0;
3469 ++acceleration_segment_index_;
3470 if (acceleration_segment_index_ >= acceleration_segment_count_)
3471 {
3472 acceleration_profile_completed_ = true;
3473 snapshot_.active_command_reached_target = true;
3474 snapshot_.command_acceleration = 0.0;
3475 snapshot_.actual_acceleration = 0.0;
3476 }
3477 }
3478 }
3479 else
3480 {
3481 snapshot_.command_position += snapshot_.command_velocity;
3482 snapshot_.actual_position = snapshot_.command_position;
3483 }
3484 return;
3485 }
3486
3487 if (!override_braking_ &&
3488 (active_command_.kind == CommandKind::move_velocity ||
3489 active_command_.kind == CommandKind::torque || continuous_holding_))
3490 {
3491 if (active_command_.kind == CommandKind::torque)
3492 {
3493 const double delta =
3494 active_command_.value - snapshot_.command_torque;
3495 if(active_command_.torque_ramp == 0.0 ||
3496 std::fabs(delta) <= active_command_.torque_ramp) {
3497 snapshot_.command_torque = active_command_.value;
3498 } else {
3499 snapshot_.command_torque +=
3500 delta < 0.0 ? -active_command_.torque_ramp
3501 : active_command_.torque_ramp;
3502 }
3503 snapshot_.command_velocity = 0.0;
3504 snapshot_.command_acceleration = 0.0;
3505 return;
3506 }
3507 const double velocity =
3508 continuous_holding_ ? continuous_hold_velocity_ : signed_velocity(active_command_);
3509 base_velocity_ = velocity;
3510 snapshot_.command_velocity = velocity;
3511 snapshot_.actual_velocity = velocity;
3512 snapshot_.command_acceleration = 0.0;
3513 snapshot_.actual_acceleration = 0.0;
3514 snapshot_.command_position += velocity;
3515 snapshot_.actual_position = snapshot_.command_position;
3516 if (!continuous_holding_ && active_command_.min_duration_cycles > 0)
3517 {
3518 ++active_tick_;
3519 if (active_tick_ >= active_command_.min_duration_cycles)
3520 {
3521 finish_active();
3522 }
3523 }
3524 return;
3525 }
3526
3527 if ((active_command_.kind == CommandKind::halt ||
3528 active_command_.kind == CommandKind::stop) &&
3529 !halt_profiled_)
3530 {
3531 finish_active();
3532 return;
3533 }
3534
3535 ++active_tick_;
3536 const otg::State1D state =
3537 otg::sample(active_profile_, rt::CycleTick::from_cycles(active_tick_));
3538 // Incremental application lets the superimposed offset compose with the
3539 // base profile without a second position bookkeeping domain.
3540 const double step = state.position - active_last_sample_;
3541 active_last_sample_ = state.position;
3542 snapshot_.command_position += step;
3543 snapshot_.command_velocity = state.velocity;
3544 snapshot_.command_acceleration = state.acceleration;
3545 snapshot_.actual_position = snapshot_.command_position;
3546 snapshot_.actual_velocity = state.velocity;
3547 snapshot_.actual_acceleration = state.acceleration;
3548 base_velocity_ = state.velocity;
3549
3550 // KB-001 velocity-threshold blending: arm once the speed exceeds the
3551 // successor's threshold of the nominal command velocity, hand over
3552 // once it falls back below. Short moves that never arm degrade to
3553 // BUFFERED; homing, halt/stop, and continuous holds do not blend.
3554 const bool blend_eligible = active_command_.kind == CommandKind::move_absolute &&
3555 !queue_.empty() &&
3556 (queue_[0].buffer_mode == BufferMode::blending_low ||
3557 queue_[0].buffer_mode == BufferMode::blending_high);
3558 if (blend_eligible)
3559 {
3560 const double nominal = active_command_.velocity * override_;
3561 const double threshold =
3562 (queue_[0].buffer_mode == BufferMode::blending_low ? 0.3 : 0.7) * nominal;
3563 const double speed = std::fabs(state.velocity);
3564 if (speed > threshold)
3565 {
3566 blend_armed_ = true;
3567 }
3568 else if (blend_armed_)
3569 {
3570 blend_into_next();
3571 return;
3572 }
3573 }
3574 else
3575 {
3576 blend_armed_ = false;
3577 }
3578
3579 if (active_tick_ >= active_profile_.duration_cycles())
3580 {
3581 if (override_braking_)
3582 {
3583 override_braking_ = false;
3584 override_paused_ = true;
3585 snapshot_.command_velocity = 0.0;
3586 snapshot_.actual_velocity = 0.0;
3587 snapshot_.command_acceleration = 0.0;
3588 snapshot_.actual_acceleration = 0.0;
3589 return;
3590 }
3591 // Timed profile segments hold at the target until their minimum
3592 // duration elapses (otg::sample keeps returning the finish state).
3593 if (active_tick_ < active_command_.min_duration_cycles)
3594 {
3595 return;
3596 }
3597 if (active_command_.kind == CommandKind::home)
3598 {
3599 snapshot_.homed = true;
3600 }
3601 if (is_continuous_kind(active_command_.kind))
3602 {
3603 snapshot_.active_command_reached_target = true;
3604 continuous_holding_ = true;
3605 snapshot_.status = AxisStatus::continuous_motion;
3606 return;
3607 }
3608 finish_active();
3609 }
3610 }

3612 void cycle_superimposed()
3613 {
3614 if (!superimposed_active_)
3615 {
3616 return;
3617 }
3618 if (!active_ && snapshot_.status == AxisStatus::standstill)
3619 {
3620 snapshot_.status = AxisStatus::discrete_motion;
3621 }
3622
3623 ++superimposed_tick_;
3624 const otg::State1D state =
3625 otg::sample(superimposed_profile_, rt::CycleTick::from_cycles(superimposed_tick_));
3626 const double step = state.position - superimposed_last_;
3627 superimposed_last_ = state.position;
3628 snapshot_.command_position += step;
3629 snapshot_.actual_position = snapshot_.command_position;
3630 snapshot_.command_velocity = base_velocity_ + state.velocity;
3631 snapshot_.actual_velocity = snapshot_.command_velocity;
3632
3633 if (superimposed_tick_ >= superimposed_profile_.duration_cycles())
3634 {
3635 superimposed_active_ = false;
3636 superimposed_completed_id_ =
3637 superimposed_halting_ ? 0 : superimposed_id_;
3638 superimposed_id_ = 0;
3639 superimposed_halting_ = false;
3640 snapshot_.command_velocity = base_velocity_;
3641 snapshot_.actual_velocity = base_velocity_;
3642 if (!active_ && snapshot_.status == AxisStatus::discrete_motion)
3643 {
3644 snapshot_.status = AxisStatus::standstill;
3645 }
3646 }
3647 }

3649 void finish_active()

3653 stop_lock_id_ == snapshot_.active_command_id && !stop_release_requested_;
3654 active_ = false;
3655 continuous_holding_ = false;
3656 base_velocity_ = 0.0;
3657 snapshot_.last_completed_command_id = snapshot_.active_command_id;
3658 snapshot_.active_command_id = 0;
3659 snapshot_.active_command_reached_target = false;
3660 snapshot_.command_velocity = 0.0;
3661 snapshot_.actual_velocity = 0.0;
3662 snapshot_.command_acceleration = 0.0;
3663 snapshot_.actual_acceleration = 0.0;
3664 snapshot_.command_torque_limit = 0.0;
3665 snapshot_.status =
3666 locked_stop
3667 ? AxisStatus::stopping
3668 : (active_command_.homing
3669 ? AxisStatus::homing
3670 : (snapshot_.powered ? AxisStatus::standstill : AxisStatus::disabled));
3671 if (active_command_.kind == CommandKind::stop && active_command_.lock_stopping &&
3672 !locked_stop)
3673 {
3674 stop_lock_id_ = 0;
3675 stop_release_requested_ = false;
3676 }
3677 if (locked_stop)

3679 return;
3680 }

3684 // KB-001 velocity-threshold blending: the queued successor takes over
3685 // while the active profile is still decelerating, planning from the live
3686 // state (the predecessor counts as completed at the handover point).

3706 queue_.pop_back();

3764 void cycle_probes()
3765 {
3766 for (std::size_t input = 0; input < DigitalInputCount; ++input)
3767 {
3768 ProbeSlot &slot = probes_[input];
3769 const bool level = digital_input_[input];
3770 const bool rising = level && !slot.last_level;
3771 slot.last_level = level;
3772 if (!slot.armed || !rising)
3773 {
3774 continue;
3775 }
3776 const double position = snapshot_.actual_position;
3777 if (slot.window_only &&
3778 (position < slot.first_position || position > slot.last_position))
3779 {
3780 continue;
3781 }
3782 slot.armed = false;
3783 slot.captured = true;
3784 slot.recorded_position = position;
3785 }

3811
3812 rt::Result<std::uint32_t> submit_management(AxisManagementCommand command,
3813 bool queued)
3814 {
3815 if(queued) {
3816 command.command_id = next_command_id_++;
3817 const rt::ErrorCode added = management_queue_.push_back(command);
3818 return added == rt::ErrorCode::ok
3819 ? rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::success(command.command_id)
3820 : rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(added);
3821 }
3822 const rt::ErrorCode result = execute_management(command);
3823 if(result != rt::ErrorCode::ok) {
3824 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::failure(result);
3825 }
3826 return rt::Result<std::uint32_t>::success(last_management_command_id_);
3827 }
3828
3829 rt::ErrorCode execute_management(AxisManagementCommand command)
3830 {
3831 if(command.command_id == 0) command.command_id = next_command_id_++;
3832 active_management_id_ = command.command_id;
3833 rt::ErrorCode result = rt::ErrorCode::ok;
3834 switch(command.kind) {
3835 case AxisManagementKind::set_position: {
3836 const AxisSnapshot before = snapshot_;
3837 const double delta = command.flag ? command.value
3838 : command.value - before.actual_position;
3839 const bool moving = before.status == AxisStatus::discrete_motion ||
3840 before.status == AxisStatus::continuous_motion ||
3841 before.status == AxisStatus::stopping;
3842 result = moving ? shift_coordinates(delta)
3843 : set_position(before.actual_position + delta);
3844 break;
3845 }
3846 case AxisManagementKind::write_parameter:
3847 result = write_parameter(command.parameter, command.value);
3848 break;
3849 case AxisManagementKind::write_bool_parameter:
3850 result = write_bool_parameter(command.parameter, command.flag);
3851 break;
3852 case AxisManagementKind::write_digital_output:
3853 result = set_digital_output(command.channel, command.flag);
3854 break;
3855 }
3856 remember_management_result(command.command_id, result);
3857 last_management_command_id_ = command.command_id;
3858 active_management_id_ = 0;
3859 return result;
3860 }
3861
3862 void cycle_management()
3863 {
3864 if(management_queue_.empty()) return;
3865 const AxisManagementCommand command = management_queue_[0];
3866 for(std::size_t i = 1; i < management_queue_.size(); ++i) {
3867 management_queue_[i - 1] = management_queue_[i];
3868 }
3869 management_queue_.pop_back();
3870 execute_management(command);
3871 }

3873 void remember_management_result(std::uint32_t command_id, rt::ErrorCode error)
3874 {
3875 if(management_results_.size() == QueueCapacity) {
3876 for(std::size_t i = 1; i < management_results_.size(); ++i) {
3877 management_results_[i - 1] = management_results_[i];
3878 }
3879 management_results_.pop_back();
3880 }
3881 management_results_.push_back({command_id, error});
3882 }

3888 void record_command_error(std::uint32_t command_id, rt::ErrorCode code)

3895 command_error_cursor_ = (command_error_cursor_ + 1) % CommandErrorCapacity;
3896 if (command_error_count_ < CommandErrorCapacity)
3897 {
3898 ++command_error_count_;
3899 }
